Enter the second door on the left.
Walk forward toward the sink.
Stop at the corner of the sink.

instruction: Exit the bedroom and enter the second room to your right with the pictures hanging above the doorway. Wait just inside that room.
plan: Walk out of the bedroom.
Turn right and walk forward.
Pass the first room on the right.
Enter the second room on the right that has pictures hanging above the doorway.
Stop and wait just inside that room.

instruction: Walk past the houseplant in the yellow pot. Turn right into the first bedroom.  Stop at the edge of the bed.
plan: Walk forward until you pass the houseplant in the yellow pot.
Turn right to enter the first bedroom.
Stop at the edge of the bed.

instruction: Exit the room by walking through the door beneath the small painting.  Walk towards the drum set.  Stop in front of the drum set.
plan: Walk to the door beneath the small painting and exit the room.
Proceed straight toward the drum set.
Stop directly in front of the drum set.

instruction: Walk forward out of the utility room. Walk forward and into the bedroom straight across from the utility room. Stop in the doorway of the bedroom.
plan: Walk forward to leave the utility room.
Continue walking straight ahead into the bedroom directly across.
Stop in the doorway of the bedroom.

instruction: Walk through the living room, past the couch. Take a hard right and enter the first room. Wait near the bed.
plan: Walk forward through the living room, passing the couch.
Turn hard right.
Enter the first room on the right.
Walk toward the bed.
Stop and wait near the bed.

instruction: Walk straight out of the room and make a hard turn left. Walk into the first room on your left and stop after taking a step.
plan: Walk straight forward to exit the room.
Make a hard turn to the left.
Walk forward into the first room on the left.
Take one step inside the room and stop.

instruction: Walk through the dining room area passed the dining table. Walk over to the blue couch near the window.
plan: Walk forward through the dining room, passing the dining table.
Turn toward the window side of the room.
Walk to the blue couch near the window and stop.

instruction: Walk into the room with the arched wall. Walk out through the door and into the hallway. Walk towards the wooden banister railing near the stariway.
plan: Walk forward and enter the room that has an arched wall.
Locate the door, walk out through it, and step into the hallway.
Proceed straight toward the wooden banister railing located near the stairway.

instruction: Go straight through the doorway and make a hard left into the first room you come to.
plan: Walk straight ahead and pass through the doorway.
Turn sharply left (hard left).
Continue forward into the first room on the left.

instruction: walk out of the closet and into the the bedroom taking a right out into the hallway and stopping at the railing overlooking the living room below.
plan: Walk forward to leave the closet and enter the bedroom.
Turn right and proceed into the hallway.
Walk to the railing overlooking the living room and stop there.

instruction: go through door, turn left, enter bathroom,.
plan: Walk forward to go through the door.
Turn left after the doorway.
Enter the bathroom.
Stop inside the bathroom.

instruction: Walk to the potted plant next to the staircase.  Enter the room to the left of the potted plant.
plan: Walk straight to the potted plant next to the staircase.
Turn left toward the room located to the left of the plant.
Enter the room.
Stop inside the room.

instruction: Walk straight to the doorway and then go through it and turn right.  Turn right again very soon.  You'll then see an empty room that contains just one window.  The walls are lined with wood paneling.
plan: Walk straight ahead to the doorway.
Go through the doorway.
Turn right.
Turn right again shortly after.
Stop inside the empty room near the window.

instruction: Go up the stairs and stop in the bathroom.
plan: Walk to the staircase entrance.
Go up the stairs to the upper floor.
Enter the bathroom on that floor.
Stop inside the bathroom.

instruction: Walk up the flight of stairs to the upper level. Walk down the hallway through the door near the guitars on the wall. Continue into the unfinished bathroom area.
plan: Walk up the flight of stairs to reach the upper level.
Turn and walk down the hallway.
Locate the door near the guitars on the wall and go through it.
Continue forward into the unfinished bathroom area.

instruction: Go to the small plain bedroom down the hall containing a six-drawer dresser on the right wall.
plan: Walk forward down the hall.
When you see a six‑drawer dresser on the right wall, continue straight ahead.
Enter the small plain bedroom at the end of the hall.
Stop inside the bedroom.

instruction: Leave the room into the next room. Once in the other room go straight into the next room and wait at the entrance.
plan: Walk out of the current room into the adjacent room.
Continue straight ahead into the next room beyond.
Stop and wait at the entrance of that room.

instruction: Walk through the door ahead of you. Make a right turn at the second doorway. Walk into the utility room.
plan: Walk straight ahead and go through the first door.
Continue forward to the second doorway and make a right turn.
Walk forward into the utility room.

instruction: Turn right and go towards the planter.  You'll turn right and walk into a bedroom.  Stand next to the bed and wait.
plan: Turn right.
Walk forward toward the planter.
Continue straight into the bedroom.
Approach the bed and stop beside it.
Wait.

instruction: Walk through door, take a right, stop right before the coach the chair in the middle.
plan: Walk straight through the door.
Turn right.
Continue walking forward until you are right in front of the couch/chair in the middle.
Stop at that position.

instruction: walk out of the pump room to the main hall. Turn slight left to the empty room, turn more left and enter the room. Stop right when you get in it and face the window.
plan: Walk straight out of the pump room into the main hall.
Turn slightly left and proceed toward the empty room.
Turn more left to enter the empty room.
Stop immediately upon entry and face the window.

instruction: Pass the meters, exit the ulity room, into the main area, and go towards the second door on the left.  Face into this room and wait.
plan: Walk forward past the meters.
Exit the utility room into the main area.
Continue toward the second door on the left.
Stop at the doorway and turn to face inside the room.
Remain stationary and wait.

instruction: Walk through the door leading into the home. Take a slight left and go straight across to the room on the left. Wait here in the bathroom.
plan: Walk through the door into the home.
Turn slightly left.
Walk straight toward the room on the left.
Enter the bathroom.
Stop and wait inside the bathroom.

instruction: Exit the room and walk slight forward. Make the 2nd right into a room full of pipes, a washing machine, and a heater. Wait in this room.
plan: Exit the current room.
Walk forward a short distance.
Take the second right turn into the room containing pipes, a washing machine, and a heater.
Stop and wait in that room.

instruction: Walk toward the bed. Turn right and walk out the door. Turn left and stop by the rail.
plan: Walk straight toward the bed.
Turn right and walk through the door.
Turn left.
Continue walking until you reach the rail.
Stop by the rail.

instruction: Leave the room and take a right. Stop at the corner on the banister that in near the corner with the drum.
plan: Walk out of the current room.
Turn right and continue walking down the corridor.
Proceed to the corner where the banister is located near the drum.
Stop at that corner.

instruction: Leave the laundry room and take a right. Go straight towards the round table, and stop before you reach the couch between the table and couch.
plan: Leave the laundry room.
Turn right.
Walk straight toward the round table.
Stop before reaching the couch that sits between the table and the couch.

instruction: Exit through the open door and make an immediate left. Enter the second room on your left, which is the bathroom and wait just inside the bathroom.
plan: Walk forward and exit through the open door.
Turn left immediately after exiting.
Move left past the first left‑hand room.
Enter the second left‑hand room, which is the bathroom.
Stop just inside the bathroom and wait.

instruction: Walk through the bathroom door to the left. Stop and wait in front of the sink.
plan: Locate the bathroom door on the left.
Walk through the door.
Proceed to the sink inside the bathroom.
Stop and wait in front of the sink.

instruction: walk between the refrigerator and counter. stop when you pass the kitchen sink.
plan: Position yourself facing the gap between the refrigerator and the countertop.
Walk forward while staying centered between the refrigerator and the countertop.
Continue walking until you see the kitchen sink on your side.
Stop immediately after passing the kitchen sink.

instruction: Go down the hallway through the door. Move through the second door on the right and stop next to the water heater.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway and pass through the door at its end.
Turn right into the side hallway.
Continue past the first door on the right and go through the second door on the right.
Stop next to the water heater.

instruction: Walk between counter and stove across  kitchen and stop in the middle of dinning room.
plan: Walk forward, staying between the counter and the stove, crossing the kitchen.
Continue straight to enter the dining room.
Stop at the center of the dining room.

instruction: Walk passed the guitars mounted on the wall. Walk into the door ahead with the potted plant at the entrance. Stop in the circular room that has a bed up against the curved ceiling wall.
plan: Walk forward past the guitars mounted on the wall.
Continue to the door ahead that has a potted plant at its entrance.
Walk into the doorway.
Move into the circular room.
Stop near the bed that is up against the curved ceiling wall.

instruction: Walk out of the door on the right. Make a slight right turn and stand by the banister.
plan: Walk out the door on the right.
Turn slightly to the right.
Proceed to the banister and stand there.

instruction: Walk up the stairs and into the room that is almost straight in front of you. Enter the room and wait.
plan: Walk up the stairs.
Continue forward toward the room that is almost straight ahead.
Enter the room.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Go forward and exit the room, turn left and enter the second door from the left, stop by the door.
plan: Walk forward to exit the room.
Turn left.
Walk forward to the second door on the left.
Enter the second door.
Stop by the door.

instruction: Walk out of the room through the door on the right. Turn right and follow the wall past the bathroom door. Wait near the wooden railings.
plan: Walk straight forward and exit the room through the door on the right.
Turn right immediately after exiting.
Follow the wall, passing the bathroom door on your left.
Stop and wait near the wooden railings.

instruction: Go down the stairs, taking a right and continuing past the kitchen. Enter the first bedroom to your right, stopping in the doorway.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Turn right at the landing.
Continue walking past the kitchen.
Enter the first bedroom on your right.
Stop in the bedroom doorway.

instruction: turn to the left and walk past the potted plant. Walk into the bathroom and stop beside the towel rack.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward past the potted plant.
Continue walking into the bathroom.
Stop beside the towel rack.

instruction: Walk down the stairs and make a left past the couch. Make a right when you're in front of the couch go down the hall then go in the bedroom on the far right and wait.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Turn left and pass the couch.
When you reach the couch, turn right and proceed down the hall.
Enter the bedroom on the far right.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Leave the room and go right.  Walk past the bar and stop in the center of the big open room.
plan: Exit the room through the doorway.
Turn right and walk down the corridor.
Continue straight, passing the bar on your left/right.
Enter the big open room.
Stop in the center of the room.

instruction: Walk up the stairs and go into the first room on the right.  Walk into the closet and stop once inside.
plan: Walk up the stairs to the next floor.
Turn right and enter the first room on the right.
Walk straight into the closet within that room.
Stop once inside the closet.

instruction: Turn to the right.  Walk  out of the door.  Then turn left and walk to the next room.  Go into the first door possible to the left.  Then stop and wait.
plan: Turn right and walk out of the door.
Turn left and walk to the next room.
Enter the first door on the left.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Walk through the pine door into the hallway. Enter the bathroom through the second door on your right. Stop in the bathroom once you pass the door.
plan: Walk forward to the pine door and go through it into the hallway.
Turn right and count the doors; proceed to the second door on the right.
Open and walk through that door to enter the bathroom.
Continue forward past the bathroom doorway.
Stop in the bathroom.

instruction: Walk through the kitchen, wait at the potted plant.
plan: Enter the kitchen.
Walk straight forward through the kitchen area.
Stop at the potted plant.

instruction: Exit the bathroom and turn left.  Walk through the first doorway on your left.  Step into the room through that doorway.  There will be a pink chair in the room.  Stop in the doorway.
plan: Exit the bathroom and turn left.
Walk to the first doorway on the left.
Walk through that doorway into the room.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: Walk up the stairs and turn right at the top. Walk through the bedroom door to the right and wait near the closet.
plan: Walk up the stairs.
Turn right at the top of the stairs.
Walk through the bedroom door on the right.
Proceed to the closet area.
Stop and wait near the closet.

instruction: Walk down the stairs and take a right. Walk forward and enter the foyer through the second door on the left. Stop inside the doorway next to the door.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Turn right.
Walk forward toward the foyer.
Enter the foyer through the second door on the left.
Stop inside the doorway next to the door.

instruction: Walk straight and then turn right at the couch. Walk straight past the guitar and then walk into the middle doorway. Wait in the entryway.
plan: Walk straight ahead.
Turn right when you reach the couch.
Continue walking straight, passing the guitar.
Walk into the middle doorway.
Stop and wait in the entryway.

instruction: Go up the stairs and take a right. Enter the bedroom that is the first door on your right and go into the closet. Stop in the closet.
plan: Walk up the stairs.
Turn right at the top of the stairs.
Enter the first door on the right (the bedroom).
Walk into the closet inside the bedroom.
Stop in the closet.

instruction: Walk past the kitchen and through the second door on the right. Wait inside the bathroom next to the sink.
plan: Walk straight ahead past the kitchen.
Turn right and identify the doors; go through the second door on the right.
Enter the room and confirm it is a bathroom.
Move to the sink area.
Stop and wait next to the sink.

instruction: Walk past the kitchen and enter the bathroom through the second door on the right. Stop in front of the bathroom sink.
plan: Walk straight ahead, passing the kitchen.
Turn right toward the bathroom area and locate the series of doors.
Count the doors on the right side and select the second one.
Enter the bathroom through that second door.
Stop directly in front of the bathroom sink.

instruction: Walk down the stairs. Walks toward the tall potted plant. Make a right into the room with a bed.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Walk toward the tall potted plant.
Turn right and enter the room with a bed.
Stop in the room.

instruction: Walk to the potted plant. Make a right into the room with the sink and tub.
plan: Walk straight until you reach the potted plant.
Turn right.
Enter the room containing the sink and tub.
Stop near the sink and tub.

instruction: Go away from the drums. Go to the plant. From the plant, go through the second doorway on the right side.
plan: Walk straight away from the drums.
Continue toward the plant and stop at the plant.
Turn right and walk past the first doorway.
Enter the second doorway on the right side of the plant.

instruction: Walk past the guitars on the wall and enter the middle door. Wait there.
plan: Walk forward past the guitars mounted on the wall.
Continue straight until you reach the set of doors and locate the middle door.
Approach the middle door.
Open the middle door and step inside.
Stop and wait at this location.

instruction: Leave the room, turn left, walk into the bedroom, turn right, and enter the closet.
plan: Walk out of the current room.
Turn left.
Walk forward into the bedroom.
Turn right.
Enter the closet.

instruction: Exit and immediately turn to the left corner. Walk inside the bedroom and turn right towards the closet, and stop there.
plan: Walk forward to exit the current room.
Immediately turn left at the corner.
Enter the bedroom.
Turn right toward the closet.
Stop at the closet.

instruction: Exit the door and turn left to the very first room. Walk inside the room and stop there.
plan: Walk forward to the door and exit the space.
Turn left immediately after exiting.
Proceed straight to the first room on the left.
Walk through the doorway into that room.
Stop inside the room.

instruction: Continue going up the stairs and then turn right and wait by the plant.
plan: Walk up the stairs to the next level.
Turn right at the landing.
Proceed toward the plant.
Stop and wait by the plant.

instruction: Walk toward the kitchen.and enter the first doorway on your left.  Stop next to the water heater in front of the washing machine.
plan: Walk straight toward the kitchen area.
Turn left and enter the first doorway on your left.
Continue forward until you see the washing machine.
Stop next to the water heater located in front of the washing machine.

instruction: Go straight and pass the yellow kitchen then turn left on the first door from the left and wait in that room by the water heater.
plan: Walk straight forward, passing the yellow kitchen.
Turn left at the first door on the left.
Enter the room through that door.
Move toward the water heater inside the room.
Stop and wait by the water heater.

instruction: Turn to your right and exit the room. Walk to your left and enter the next room. Walk in and enter the closet on your left. Stop when you are at the clothes hanging and on shelves.
plan: Turn right and exit the current room.
Walk left and enter the next room.
Enter the closet on the left side of that room.
Stop when you reach the area with hanging clothes and shelves.

instruction: Go through the door and make a right and head towards the drum set.
plan: Walk forward through the door.
Turn right.
Walk straight toward the drum set.
Stop near the drum set.

instruction: Head up the stairs, turn right and stop in front of the doorway by the plant.
plan: Walk up the stairs to the next level.
Turn right at the top of the stairs.
Continue forward toward the doorway.
Stop directly in front of the doorway by the plant.

instruction: Walk down the steps and turn right. Walk forward past the guitar. Walk into the second door to the left. Stop just inside the door.
plan: Walk down the steps and turn right at the landing.
Continue walking forward, passing the guitar.
Identify the second door on the left and walk into it.
Stop just inside the doorway.

instruction: Go straight into the third room starting from the left and stop when you go into the closet on the left.
plan: Walk forward until you reach the third room counting from the left.
Enter the third room.
Turn left and go into the closet on the left side of the room.
Stop as you enter the closet.

instruction: Leave the bathroom, turn right, turn right again, and wait by the drums.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn right.
Turn right again.
Proceed to the drums and stop there.

instruction: Walk froward and enter the room to the left of the stairs. In the room take a left and enter the closet. Stop in the doorway to the closet.
plan: Walk forward to reach the stairs.
Turn left and enter the room located to the left of the stairs.
Inside that room, turn left to enter the closet.
Stop in the doorway of the closet.

instruction: Walk forward toward the door directly left of the plant. Walk into the bedroom. Take a slight left. Walk into the closet. Wait there.
plan: Walk forward toward the door directly left of the plant.
Walk through the door and enter the bedroom.
Take a slight left turn inside the bedroom.
Walk into the closet.
Stop and wait inside the closet.

instruction: walk away from the drumset, walk past one doorway on your left and walk through the second doorway on your left. Stop once inside.
plan: Walk straight away from the drumset.
Continue forward and pass the first doorway on your left.
Enter the second doorway on your left.
Stop once you are inside.

instruction: Walk toward the couch and turn right. Walk into the second door on the right and stop just inside the bathroom.
plan: Walk forward until you reach the couch.
Turn right at the couch.
Continue walking to the wall with doors and locate the second door on the right.
Walk through that second door on the right.
Stop just inside the bathroom.

instruction: Take a right past the guitar and go to the bathroom that is the second door on the right.
plan: Turn right onto the hallway.
Walk forward past the guitar.
Continue straight to the first door on the right and pass it.
Stop at the second door on the right (the bathroom).

instruction: Walk down the stairs and turn right. Walk past the couch and into the hallway. Walk into the third door from the right and stop just inside the doorway.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Turn right and continue down the hallway, passing the couch.
Proceed to the third door on the right.
Stop just inside that doorway.

plan: Walk forward away from the couch toward the staircase landing.
Continue straight to pass under the landing.
Locate the five doors in front of you.
Enter the doorway immediately to the right of the center door.
Walk forward into the bathroom and stop in front of the mirror.

instruction: Walk through kitchen past yellow cabinets and go left at the door, wait by water heater.
plan: Walk forward through the kitchen, passing the yellow cabinets.
Continue to the doorway and turn left.
Walk straight to the water heater.
Stop and wait by the water heater.

instruction: Go down the stairs. Walk toward the kitchen area. Turn right. There are 5 doorways here. Go through the very middle one into the empty room. Stop a couple of feet inside of that room.
plan: Go down the stairs.
Walk toward the kitchen area.
Turn right.
Pass through the middle doorway of the five doorways into the empty room.
Stop a couple of feet inside the room.

instruction: Walk up the stairs. Wait at the potted plant on the landing.
plan: Walk toward the staircase entrance.
Ascend the stairs to the landing.
Stop at the potted plant on the landing.
Wait at the plant.

instruction: Walk past the couch and across the room. Walk through the third doorway from the left. Stop just inside the doorway.
plan: Walk forward past the couch.
Continue straight across the room.
Identify the third doorway on the left side of the room.
Walk through that doorway.
Stop just inside the doorway.

instruction: exit toilet room to hall and turn hard right, stop in front of drum set.
plan: Walk out of the toilet room into the hall.
Turn hard right.
Walk forward toward the drum set.
Stop directly in front of the drum set.

instruction: Go inside and wait right at the entrance of the third door from your left.
plan: Walk straight forward to go inside the building.
Look to your left and count the doors, identifying the third door from the left.
Move to the entrance of that third left‑hand door.
Stop and wait at the door entrance.

instruction: Walk forward past the couch. Enter the second door from the left which is the entry way. Stop in the doorway to the entryway.
plan: Walk straight ahead past the couch.
Turn left to face the row of doors.
Enter the second door from the left (the entryway).
Stop in the doorway of the entryway.

instruction: Turn left and look at the painting. Turn right and move forward past the guitar and keep going through the hallway entrance to wait in front of the brown wooden door.
plan: Turn left.
Look at the painting.
Turn right.
Walk forward past the guitar and continue through the hallway entrance.
Stop in front of the brown wooden door.

instruction: Turn right to face the end of the yellow kitchen with a set of stairs on the right and a table on the left. Walk past the kitchen to the collection of doors at the end of the house. Walk though the door in the middle that has two pictures above it. The door leads to an empty room with a single window.
plan: Turn right to face the end of the yellow kitchen (stairs on the right, table on the left).
Walk straight past the kitchen toward the collection of doors at the far end of the house.
Enter the middle door that has two pictures above it.
Stop in the empty room that contains a single window.

instruction: Go straight and go into the fourth door from the right. Wait by the sink.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway.
Count the doors on the right and stop at the fourth one.
Enter the fourth door from the right.
Proceed to the sink inside the room.
Stop and wait by the sink.

instruction: Exit the room and walk toward the door near the potted plant.  Stop in the doorway leading into the bedroom.
plan: Walk straight ahead to exit the current room.
Turn toward the door located near the potted plant.
Continue walking until you reach the doorway that leads into the bedroom.
Stop in the center of that doorway.

instruction: Go past the stairs, and a guitar and go into the middle doorway.  Stand in the doorway facing an empty room with a door at the other end.
plan: Walk forward, passing the stairs and the guitar on your left/right.
Continue to the middle doorway and step inside.
Stop in the doorway.
Face toward the empty room, keeping the door at the opposite end in view.

instruction: Exit the room through the open door.  Enter the room on the left and wait by the doorway.
plan: Walk to the open door and exit the room.
Turn left and step through the doorway into the left room.
Stop and wait by the doorway of that room.

instruction: Walk out of the under stairs, and take a right. Enter the bathroom throuhg the door second on the right. Stop once you are past the door.
plan: Walk out of the space under the stairs.
Turn right and proceed down the hallway.
Locate the second door on the right and walk through it into the bathroom.
Continue forward past the doorway and stop.

instruction: Walk into the bedroom and then walk out of the bedroom and take a right. Walk into the playroom and wait there.
plan: Walk forward into the bedroom.
Walk backward (or exit) out of the bedroom.
Turn right.
Walk forward into the playroom.
Stop and wait in the playroom.

instruction: Walk down the stairs and turn right at the couch. Take a right into the middle room on the right. Wait in this room.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Turn right at the couch.
Continue right into the middle room on the right.
Stop and wait in this room.

instruction: Walk across the room and wait through the second door on the right, in the bathroom .
plan: Walk straight ahead across the room.
Turn right to face the doors on the wall.
Pass the first door on the right and go through the second door on the right.
Enter the bathroom.
Stop and wait inside the bathroom.

instruction: Walk through the doorway and turn right.  Stop in the kitchen area next to the sink.
plan: Walk forward through the doorway.
Turn right.
Continue straight until you reach the kitchen area.
Stop next to the sink.

instruction: walk down the hall, turn left stop at the counter.
plan: Walk forward down the hallway.
Turn left.
Stop at the counter.

instruction: Exit out the door in front of you. Once out turn left and enter the next room to the left. Stop inside the door of the next bedroom.
plan: Walk forward to exit through the door in front of you.
Turn left after stepping outside.
Walk forward to the doorway of the next room on the left.
Enter the room (the bedroom).
Stop inside the bedroom doorway.

instruction: Step into the bedroom and turn right. Walk out of the bedroom through the door and turn right. Walk through the first doorway on the right and wait just inside the art room.
plan: Walk into the bedroom and turn right.
Exit the bedroom through its door and turn right.
Walk to the first doorway on the right and go through it.
Continue forward into the art room and stop just inside.

instruction: Exit the closet and turn right.  Then exit the bedroom and turn right.  Walk into the art room and stand near the chair.
plan: Exit the closet.
Turn right.
Exit the bedroom.
Turn right.
Walk into the art room and stand near the chair.

instruction: Walk around the round table towards the kitchen counter. Turn right at the kitchen counter towards the refrigerator, and stop there.
plan: Walk around the round table heading toward the kitchen counter.
Arrive at the kitchen counter.
Turn right at the kitchen counter.
Walk toward the refrigerator.
Stop at the refrigerator.

instruction: Exit the room into the main area. Stop in the doorway straight across from the utility room.
plan: Walk to and exit through the door of the current room into the main area.
Continue straight ahead down the main area corridor.
Identify the doorway that is directly across from the utility room.
Stop at that doorway.

instruction: Walk forward to the area with the doors. Enter the bedroom through the first door on your right. Stop once you have passed the door.
plan: Walk forward until you reach the area with the doors.
Turn right and approach the first door on your right.
Open the door and walk through it into the bedroom.
Continue moving forward past the doorway and then stop.

instruction: walk straight away from the door to the outside, past the kitchen on the left and stairs on the right, walk into the room straight ahead and stop once you make it in the room.
plan: Walk straight ahead away from the door toward the outside.
Continue forward, passing the kitchen on the left and the stairs on the right.
Enter the room that is straight ahead.
Stop once you are inside the room.

instruction: Go down the hall and turn right then stop next to the kitchen sink.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn right.
Continue forward toward the kitchen area.
Stop next to the kitchen sink.

instruction: You need to leave the room with the water tanks and make a right just outside the door. When you get next to the sink wait.
plan: Walk out of the water tanks room through the doorway.
Immediately turn right as you step outside the door.
Continue walking straight toward the sink.
Stop and wait when you arrive next to the sink.

instruction: Turn left and face the yellow counter. Travel between the counter and the black table to the window. Turn right and travel to the fridge.
plan: Turn left and face the yellow counter.
Walk forward between the counter and the black table until you reach the window.
Turn right.
Walk forward to the fridge.

instruction: Leave the room and walk to the couch. Stop in front of the right side of the couch.
plan: Walk out of the room through the doorway.
Move straight toward the couch.
Stop directly in front of the right side of the couch.

instruction: Turn right and walk to the door on the right 2nd closest to the stairs. Stop once you enter the door and are looking at the bathroom .
plan: Turn right.
Walk forward until you reach the second door on the right that is closest to the stairs.
Open and enter that door.
Stop inside the room and face the bathroom.

instruction: Exit the bathroom and enter the bedroom. Wait there.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn toward the bedroom doorway.

plan: Approach the staircase entrance.
Begin descending the stairs.
Watch the floor ahead for a triangular‑shaped section.
When the triangle‑shaped floor with a guardrail appears, stop moving.

instruction: Go through the room out of the bathroom, go into the bedroom make a right through the bedroom through the door and wait just outside that door.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom into the adjacent space.
Enter the bedroom through its doorway.
Turn right inside the bedroom.
Move straight to the bedroom door and exit.
Stop and wait just outside the bedroom door.

instruction: Go all the way down the stairs and stop once you reach the bottom.
plan: Position yourself at the top of the staircase.
Walk down the stairs to the bottom landing.
Stop when you reach the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: Go up the stairs and take a right. Take a right at the second arch past the sink. take a left and stop in the doorway.
plan: Walk up the stairs.
Turn right at the top of the stairs.
Continue forward and, at the second arch past the sink, turn right.
Immediately after, turn left.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: Walk down the steps and make a sharp turn left. Walk down the steps and stop at the bottom of the stairs.
plan: Walk down the steps.
Make a sharp turn to the left.
Walk down the next set of steps.
Stop at the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: Go all the way up the stairs and turn into the first door on the left. Stop outside of the bathroom, the first door on the left in the long hall.
plan: Walk to the staircase and ascend all the way to the top floor.
Upon reaching the top, turn left into the hallway.
Continue straight until you reach the first door on the left.
Stop immediately outside that door (the bathroom).

instruction: Go down the stairs until you get to the middle and wait 3 steps before going all the way down.
plan: Walk down the stairs until you reach the middle landing.
Pause and take three steps forward (or in place) on the middle landing.
Resume walking down the stairs to the bottom.
Stop at the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: Go down the stairs to the next floor. Stop at the bottom of the stairs.
plan: Walk down the stairs to the next floor.
Stop at the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: Leave the room and take a left. Head through the dining room and enter the door on the left. Stop in the doorway.
plan: Walk out of the room.
Turn left.
Proceed straight through the dining room.
Enter the door on the left.
Stop inside the doorway.

instruction: Leave the dining room through the door to the right of the dining table.  Walk past the but and enter the doorway on the opposite from where you started.  Stop when you are standing in this doorway into the room with the round couch.
plan: Walk straight out of the dining room through the door on the right side of the dining table.
Continue forward, passing the object directly ahead (the "but").
Enter the doorway that is opposite the one you just exited.
Stop once you are standing inside the room with the round couch.

instruction: Go up the steps then turn right and  go straight past the round table after you pass the round table turn right between the large white marble pot on the left and the fake sink on the right. Then turn left wait near the black and red carpet.
plan: Walk up the steps.
Turn right and walk straight past the round table.
After passing the table, turn right and go between the large white marble pot (left) and the fake sink (right).
Turn left.
Stop near the black and red carpet.

instruction: Walk straight across the room and stop in the door way.
plan: Walk forward toward the opposite wall of the room.
Continue straight until you reach the doorway.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: Exit through the open doors and turn left. Continue straight past the table and bath tub. Enter the room on the left and wait by the doorway.
plan: Walk forward to exit through the open doors and immediately turn left.
Continue straight, passing the table and the bathtub.
Enter the room located on the left side.
Stop and wait by the doorway inside the room.

instruction: Go upstairs, turn right and go upstairs, turn into the leftmost doorway, take a few steps and then stop.
plan: Walk up the first flight of stairs.
Turn right and ascend the next flight of stairs.
Turn into the leftmost doorway.
Take a few steps forward inside the doorway.
Stop.

instruction: Leave the pantry through the door on the left. Walk into the dining room and take a right. Walk to the door to the outside and stop with stairs on either side of you.
plan: Walk out of the pantry through the door on the left.
Enter the dining room and turn right.
Continue walking straight to the door that leads outside.
Stop at the outside door with stairs on either side of you.

instruction: Exit the room and walk straight across the next room. Wait in front of the bathroom.
plan: Exit the current room.
Walk straight ahead across the next room.
Stop and wait in front of the bathroom.

instruction: Exit the room, walk towards the exit and wait at the top of the staircases.
plan: Turn toward the room’s exit doorway.
Walk through the doorway to exit the room.
Continue forward toward the building’s main exit.
Arrive at the top of the staircases.
Stop and wait there.

instruction: Enter and the large room, walking to the right of the long wooden table with several lamps on it. Walk directly straight ahead through the door in front of you. Then continue and stop in the doorway of the bedroom.
plan: Enter the large room.
Walk to the right side of the long wooden table with the lamps.
Walk straight ahead through the door directly in front of you.
Continue forward and stop in the doorway of the bedroom.

instruction: Walk up the stairs, then turn right and wait in the foyer near the stairway.
plan: Walk up the stairs to the landing.
Turn right onto the foyer floor.
Stop and wait near the stairway in the foyer.

instruction: Turn to your left and exit the room. Go across the next room and enter the door straight across. Stop once you enter the bathroom door.
plan: Turn left and walk out of the current room.
Continue straight forward through the next room.
Enter the door directly across from where you entered (the bathroom door).
Stop once inside the bathroom.

instruction: Walk up stairs, and turn towards the round table in the center of the room. Make a right. Walk through the archway, to the left of the white pedestal with sink handles and a faucet on top. Make a left just before the hall mirror. Wait at the entrance to the hallway.
plan: Walk up the stairs.
Turn toward the round table in the center of the room and then make a right.
Walk through the archway that is to the left of the white pedestal with sink handles and a faucet on top.
Make a left turn just before reaching the hall mirror.
Stop and wait at the entrance to the hallway.

instruction: Continue all the way up the stairs. Turn right and stop after a couple of feet in the middle of the room.
plan: Walk up the stairs until you reach the landing at the top.
Turn right when you reach the landing.
Walk forward a couple of feet into the room.
Stop in the middle of the room.

instruction: Leave the salon and walk past the table. Go through the door straight across. Stop in the doorway.
plan: Leave the salon.
Walk forward past the table.
Continue straight to the door directly ahead.
Go through the door.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: Walk forward and enter the room. Turn right and walk past all the sinks. Once you pass the sinks, turn right and stop in the doorway.
plan: Walk forward and enter the room.
Turn right.
Walk straight, passing all the sinks.
Turn right.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: Walk out of the dining room and towards the tub.  When you reach the tub, turn left and walk down the room past the sinks and dining table until you reach the other tub on the other end of the room.  Turn left at the tub and stop in the doorway of the sitting room.
plan: Walk out of the dining room toward the first tub.
When you reach the first tub, turn left and walk straight, passing the sinks and dining table, until you arrive at the second tub at the far end of the room.
Turn left at the second tub and stop in the doorway of the sitting room.

instruction: Walk out of the bathroom stall and past the sink area. Continue through the open door at the end of the bathroom. Walk across the hall towards the open double doors directly ahead. Walk into the large dining room and stop near the armchairs around the fireplace.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom stall and move past the sink area.
Continue through the open door at the end of the bathroom.
Walk across the hall toward the open double doors directly ahead.
Walk into the large dining room through the double doors.
Stop near the armchairs around the fireplace.

instruction: turn left, then go right, stop near the doormat near the house door.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward.
Turn right.
Continue forward toward the doormat near the house door.
Stop by the doormat.

instruction: Go straight across the dining room into the beige doorway and then straight again into a second doorway and a bedroom and then stop.
plan: Walk straight across the dining room toward the beige doorway.
Enter the beige doorway and keep walking forward.
Pass through the second doorway into the bedroom.
Stop inside the bedroom.

instruction: Walk forward into the room and turn right. Go across the room past all the sinks and turn into the last door on your right. Stop once you are in the doorway.
plan: Walk forward into the room.
Turn right.
Walk straight across the room, passing all the sinks.
Turn into the last door on your right.
Stop once you are in the doorway.

instruction: Turn right and go up the stairs. At the top, walk forward and enter the door to your left. Stop once you enter the hallway.
plan: Turn right.
Go up the stairs.
Walk forward at the top of the stairs.
Enter the door on your left.
Stop once you are inside the hallway.

instruction: Go up the stairs and when you get to the top, turn right and walk a few steps before stopping.
plan: Walk up the stairs to the landing.
Turn right at the top of the stairs.
Walk forward a few steps.
Stop at that point.

instruction: Exit the bathroom then go straight into the double doors. Wait near the chairs.
plan: Exit the bathroom.
Walk straight ahead toward the double doors.
Pass through the double doors.
Continue forward until you reach the area with chairs.
Stop and wait near the chairs.

instruction: Go in to the hallways with a rug. Stop before you reach the rug and turn left into the room. Stop right inside the doorway.
plan: Walk forward down the hallway toward the rug.
Stop just before reaching the rug.
Turn left to enter the adjacent room.
Stop right inside the doorway.

instruction: Go up the rest of the stairs and at the top, walk to the doorway on the left.  Stop after stepping into the hallway.
plan: Walk up the stairs to the top level.
Turn left (or orient toward the left side) at the top of the stairs.
Walk straight to the doorway on the left.
Step through the doorway into the hallway.
Stop after stepping into the hallway.

instruction: Turn left and enter the hallway. Once in the hallway turn left into the first door. Stop once you enter the room and are facing the long table.
plan: Turn left and walk into the hallway.
In the hallway, turn left.
Enter the first door on the left.
Stop inside the room, positioned to face the long table.

instruction: Walk straight across the room and go through the left archway. Turn right and wait between the two archways.
plan: Walk straight across the room.
Go through the left archway.
Turn right.
Move to a spot between the two archways.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Walk up the stairs to your left. Turn left into the first hallway and briefly walk until you hit the set of double doors to your right. Wait there.
plan: Walk up the stairs located to your left.
Turn left and enter the first hallway.
Walk straight until you see double doors on your right.
Stop at the double doors and wait.

instruction: Go straight unto the arch ahead. Turn slightly right and wait near the picture frame over the white pedestal.
plan: Walk straight ahead toward the arch.
Pass through or reach the arch.
Turn slightly right.
Move toward the white pedestal with the picture frame.
Stop and wait near the picture frame.

instruction: Walk down the stairs and turn to the left. Continue down the stairs to the bottom and enter the showroom to your left.  Stand near the bath tub.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Turn left and continue down the stairs to the bottom level.
Enter the showroom on the left.
Walk toward the bathtub.
Stop near the bathtub.

instruction: Go through the door and turn right. Walk right passed the table and continue towards the bathtub, turn right and stop in the doorway.
plan: Walk through the door.
Turn right.
Walk right past the table toward the bathtub.
Turn right.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: Walk down the stairs to the landing and turn left. Walk down the second set of stairs.  Walk past the fire extinguisher and turn left.  Wait inside the gallery at the bottom of the steps.
plan: Walk down the first set of stairs to the landing.
Turn left at the landing.
Walk down the second set of stairs.
Walk past the fire extinguisher and turn left.
Wait inside the gallery at the bottom of the steps.

instruction: Leave the bathroom and enter the doorway across the hall. Stop near the wooden table.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn toward the hallway and cross to the doorway opposite.
Enter the doorway.
Walk toward the wooden table.
Stop near the wooden table.

instruction: Turn left and go passed the table. At the end of the long table, pass the bathtub and cross into the room. Stop next to the stairs.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward past the table until you reach its end.
Continue forward past the bathtub and enter the adjacent room.
Stop next to the stairs.

instruction: Turn left and walk down the hall, at the first door turn left and stop.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward down the hallway until you reach the first door.
Turn left at the first door and stop.

instruction: Exit the door beneath the exit sign.  Turn left, and walk towards silver bathtub.  Enter room behind bathtub.  Wait at bottom of stairs.
plan: Walk through the door located beneath the exit sign.
Turn left.
Walk straight toward the silver bathtub.
Enter the room situated behind the bathtub.
Stop and wait at the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: Exit the room through the open door. Walk past the table and the bathtub. Go through the double doors and wait at the bottom of the stairs.
plan: Exit the room through the open door.
Walk forward, passing the table and then the bathtub.
Continue through the double doors.
Stop and wait at the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: walk away from piano through double doors with bookshelf on left, turn right and stop in doorway.
plan: Walk forward away from the piano toward the double doors.
Pass through the double doors, keeping the bookshelf on your left.
Continue straight after exiting the doors.
Turn right.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: Walk across the room, through the archway and wait near the mirror.
plan: Walk straight across the room toward the archway.
Pass through the archway.
Continue toward the mirror.
Stop and wait near the mirror.

instruction: Walk forward toward the doorway, and wait at the top of the staircase.
plan: Walk straight ahead toward the doorway.
Pass through the doorway and continue up the staircase.
Stop and wait at the landing at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Go down the stairs. Turn left and continue going down the stairs. Turn left and go down the steps. Wait there.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Turn left and continue down the stairs.
Turn left and continue down the stairs.
Stop and wait at the landing.

instruction: Turn left and walk past the really long table. Stand near the front entrance doors.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward past the really long table.
Continue toward the front entrance doors.
Stop near the front entrance doors.

instruction: Exit the room and walk straight into the room across. Pass the bed and go into the second room on the left. Wait near the white bench on the right.
plan: Exit the room you are currently in.
Walk straight ahead into the room directly across.
Pass the bed and turn into the second doorway on the left.
Move toward the right side of that room and stop near the white bench.

instruction: Walk down the stairs and stop at the bottom landing near the rail.
plan: Face the staircase and step onto the first stair.
Continue descending each step until you reach the bottom landing.
Position yourself near the rail on the landing.
Stop.

instruction: Turn around so that you are facing the open doorway.  Walk towards the two open white doors.  Walk through the doors.  Proceed down the hall until you reach an open doorway on your right.  Stop and turn ninety degrees until you are facing the open doorway.  Walk through the open doorway and stop.  You are in a large room, and there should be a large table in front of you.
plan: Turn around to face the open doorway.
Walk forward to the two open white doors and pass through them.
Continue down the hall until an open doorway appears on your right; turn ninety degrees to face that doorway.
Walk through the doorway and stop in the large room, where a large table is directly ahead.

instruction: Go down the stairs to the landing. Stop on the landing.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Continue until you reach the landing.
Stop on the landing.

instruction: Once you are in the library make a right and go through the door to the room with the glasses. Now make a right to leave the area and wait in the doorway.
plan: Turn right while standing in the library.
Walk through the door into the room with the glasses.
Turn right to leave the glasses room.
Move to the doorway and stop (wait).

instruction: Turn around and go to the large archway. At the arches, continue to the front door and stop.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk straight to the large archway.
Continue walking straight toward the front door.
Stop at the front door.

instruction: Go down the stairs and stop in the middle when you reach the point where it joins with another staircase.
plan: Walk down the staircase.
Continue descending until you reach the intersection where a second staircase joins.
Stop at that junction point (the middle of the stairs).

instruction: Walk across the hall and through the bedroom. Stop just inside the bathroom.
plan: Walk straight across the hall.
Turn into the bedroom and walk through it.
Enter the bathroom.
Stop just inside the bathroom.

instruction: Walk towards the door with the dining table to your left. Walk through the door and into the room with one handing light  and a picture on the left side of the wall. Walk past the painting and through the doorway onto the tile.
plan: Walk forward toward the door that has the dining table on your left.
Go through that door into the room with one hanging light and a picture on the left wall.
Continue straight, passing the picture on the left.
Walk through the doorway ahead onto the tiled area.

instruction: Walk past the round table on the left. Walk through the open door on the right. Enter the open bedroom door. Walk past the foot of the bed on the right. Enter the bathroom. Wait at the towel warmer on the wall to the left.
plan: Walk forward past the round table on your left.
Turn right and go through the open door, entering the bedroom.
Continue forward past the foot of the bed on your right and enter the bathroom.
Stop and wait at the towel warmer on the left wall.

instruction: Go through the wooden double doors and walk to first door on your left. Go up three stairs and wait on the landing.
plan: Walk through the wooden double doors.
Continue forward to the first door on your left.
Turn toward the staircase and approach the steps.
Ascend three stairs.
Stop and wait on the landing.

instruction: Walk forward through the closest doorway. Go straight ahead into the bedroom across. Go into the bathroom. Stop in front of the first window.
plan: Walk forward through the closest doorway.
Continue straight ahead into the bedroom across.
Enter the bathroom.
Stop in front of the first window.

instruction: Walk across dinning room table and turn left into room with barber chair. Wait at chair.
plan: Walk straight forward, crossing the dining room table.
Turn left and enter the adjacent room with the barber chair.
Stop near the barber chair and wait.

instruction: Exit the room and go through the doors on the left. Stop on the landing, at the top of the steps.
plan: Walk straight to the exit of the current room and step outside.
Turn left and walk through the set of doors on the left.
Continue forward until you reach the landing at the top of the stairs.
Stop on the landing.

instruction: Turn around and exit into the room with the large table. Once out, walk to the left side into the sitting area and enter the door on the far left. Once you exit, tun left and walk through the doorway. Stop once you reach the room with the stairs.
plan: Turn around and walk forward to exit into the room with the large table.
Turn left, walk to the left side of that room and enter the sitting area through the far‑left door.
Exit the sitting area, turn left, and walk through the next doorway.
Continue straight until you arrive at the room with the stairs.
Stop.

instruction: Go into the doorway that leads to a bed. Go past the bed and through the door.
plan: Approach and walk into the doorway that leads to the bed.
Move forward past the bed.
Continue straight to the adjacent door.
Walk through the door to exit the area.

instruction: Walk down to the far end of the dining room and turn left into the double doors. Stop and wait near the barber's chair.
plan: Walk straight ahead to the far end of the dining room.
Turn left and approach the double doors.
Walk through the double doors.
Locate the barber's chair inside the next area.
Stop and wait near the barber's chair.

instruction: Go past the white couches and exit the room using the double doors. Turn left and go up three steps of the stairs.
plan: Walk straight past the white couches.
Exit the room using the double doors.
Turn left immediately after exiting.
Ascend the three steps of the stairs.

instruction: Head out through the dining room and into the door nearest the fireplace, then turn left. Stop in the landing and wait near the stairs.
plan: Walk through the dining room toward the fireplace.
Open and go through the door closest to the fireplace.
Turn left.
Walk to the landing.
Stop and wait near the stairs.

instruction: Exit bedroom, make a left then a sharp right, stop at the stair landing, in front of the glass door.
plan: Walk out of the bedroom.
Turn left.
Make a sharp right turn.
Proceed to the stair landing.
Stop in front of the glass door.

instruction: Leave the bedroom through the door on the right.  Walk in your one o'clock position until you see a door going outside and walk towards it.  Stop when you are standing at the top of two sets of stairs, a few feet in front of the door going outside.
plan: Walk straight out through the bedroom door on the right.
Turn to face roughly the one‑o’clock direction and move forward.
Continue until you see the door that leads outside, then proceed toward it.
Stop a few feet in front of that exterior door, positioned at the top of the two sets of stairs.

instruction: Turn around and exit the bathroom. Once in the hallway, turn right and stop once you walk through the doorway.
plan: Turn around to face the bathroom exit.
Walk forward and exit the bathroom through the doorway.
In the hallway, turn right.
Walk forward through the next doorway.
Stop immediately after entering the doorway.

instruction: Turn around, go left across the room, enter the hallway and turn left, exit onto the stairway landing and wait there.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk left across the room.
Enter the hallway and turn left.
Exit the hallway onto the stairway landing.
Stop and wait on the landing.

instruction: Walk out of the bathroom and turn right. Walk into the first doorway on the right and stop.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom to the doorway.
Turn right.
Walk forward to the first doorway on the right and enter it.
Stop inside the doorway.

instruction: Exit the bathroom and turn right.  Go through the doorway and stop just after stepping off the mat on the other side.
plan: Exit the bathroom.
Turn right.
Walk through the doorway.
Step off the mat on the other side.
Stop.

instruction: Exit living, pass the dinning table and make a right door, stop at bar area door.
plan: Walk forward to exit the living room.
Continue straight, passing the dining table.
Turn right into the doorway ahead.
Proceed to the bar area door and stop.

instruction: Exit bathroom, turn right. walk down hall and stop at other bathroom.
plan: Exit the bathroom through the doorway.
Turn right.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Stop when you reach the other bathroom.

instruction: Walk around the table on the left side. Leave the dining room and enter the salon through the double doors on the left of the table. Stop once you enter the room.
plan: Walk around the table on its left side.
Move toward the double doors located to the left of the table.
Go through the double doors, leaving the dining room.
Enter the salon through the same doors.
Stop once inside the salon.

instruction: Turn right and exit the room. Turn left and then turn right and walk toward the stairs. Wait at the top of the stairs.
plan: Turn right and exit the room.
Turn left.
Turn right.
Walk toward the stairs.
Stop and wait at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Walk out of the bathroom and turn right. Stop just inside the doorway.
plan: Walk forward to exit the bathroom.
Turn right.
Move a short distance inside the doorway and stop.

instruction: Turn left and pass the large table and chairs. Pass the tub and wait near the double doors.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward, passing the large table and chairs.
Continue forward, passing the tub.
Stop near the double doors.

instruction: Exit the bathroom. Turn right and go straight until you get to the second door on the right. Turn right and go into the room. Wait there.
plan: Exit the bathroom.
Turn right.
Walk straight until you reach the second door on the right.
Turn right and enter the room.
Wait inside the room.

instruction: Walk down the length of the room past the long table and stop after passing the tub at the end in front of the door to the left.
plan: Walk straight forward, passing the long table.
Continue walking past the tub located at the end of the room.
Stop in front of the door on the left side.

instruction: With the wall containing the fireplace behind you, walk forward with the long table to your left, exiting through the double doors on your right after passing the long table.Stop after moving from the wooden floor to the stone tiles.
plan: Walk forward, keeping the long table on your left.
Continue past the long table until the double doors appear on your right.
Exit through the double doors.
Stop immediately after stepping onto the stone‑tiled floor (leaving the wooden floor).

instruction: Walk through the bathroom and out the door, take a right turn through the other open door and stop at your destination.
plan: Walk forward through the bathroom door.
Continue straight until you exit the bathroom.
Turn right and pass through the adjacent open door.
Walk forward down the hallway.
Stop at the destination.

instruction: Go down the stairs to your right and stop once you reach the bottom.
plan: Turn to face the stairs on your right.
Walk down the stairs to the lower level.
Stop when you reach the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: Leave the sitting area and walk to towards the large wooden table.  Walk on right side of the table. Turn right at the white double doors. Stop inside the doorway.
plan: Walk out of the sitting area.
Proceed toward the large wooden table.
Move along the right side of the table.
Turn right when you reach the white double doors.
Stop inside the doorway.

instruction: Turn right and head down the stairs. Turn left at the landing and continue down the stairs until you reach the next landing. Wait by the white railing at the center of the landing.
plan: Turn right.
Walk down the stairs.
At the landing, turn left and continue down the stairs.
Proceed until you reach the next landing.
Stop and wait by the white railing at the center of the landing.

instruction: Turn to the inside of the house. Walk to the short marble column. Turn right. Walk towards the mirror. Turn left at doorway. Turn right at first door. Stop at doorway to bedroom.
plan: Turn inward and walk to the short marble column.
Turn right and walk toward the mirror.
Turn left at the doorway.
Turn right at the first door.
Stop at the bedroom doorway.

instruction: Exit bathroom and turn right. Stop in doorway.
plan: Walk straight out of the bathroom.
Turn right at the exit.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: After you leave the bathroom take a right and wait in the doorway.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn right.
Proceed to the doorway and stop there to wait.

instruction: Walk down the hallway on the carpet and keep going straight after the carpet ends.  Stop in front of the last door on the left.
plan: Walk forward along the hallway while on the carpet.
When the carpet ends, continue walking straight ahead.
Proceed until you reach the leftmost (last) door in the hallway.
Stop directly in front of that door.

instruction: Go to the long brown table with two chairs. Go to the left side of the bathtub.
plan: Walk straight to the long brown table with two chairs.
Stop at the table.
Turn toward the bathtub.
Walk to the left side of the bathtub.
Stop at the left side of the bathtub.

instruction: Go into the big room towards the table and then to the right, at the circle table turn right and go towards the tall mirror, make a left and go into the archway and then turn right into the grey doorway and stop.
plan: Walk into the big room, proceed toward the circle table, and turn right at the table.
Continue toward the tall mirror, then turn left to enter the archway.
Turn right into the grey doorway and stop.

instruction: Walk down the stairs, then wait on the third stair from the landing on the far side of the hand rail.
plan: Walk down the stairs toward the landing.
Identify the far side of the hand rail.
Move to the third stair away from the landing on that side.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Turn right and walk down the hallway with the carpet. Continue walking past the first doorway. Stop in front of the doorway with double doors.
plan: Turn right.
Walk forward down the hallway with the carpet.
Continue past the first doorway you encounter.
Stop directly in front of the doorway that has double doors.

instruction: Turn slightly to the left, then head that way before turning hard right followed by a slight left until you've made it to the very first room on the right then stop at the doorway.
plan: Turn slightly to the left.
Walk forward in that direction.
Turn hard right.
Turn slight left and continue until the first room on the right appears.
Stop at the doorway of that room.

instruction: Keeping the tapestry on your left, walk straight through the dining room and out the door.  Turn right when you get to the tub in the next room and stop just before going up the stairs.
plan: Walk straight, keeping the tapestry on your left, through the dining room to the door.
Exit the door into the next room.
Turn right when you reach the tub.
Walk forward toward the stairs.
Stop just before the stairs.

instruction: Turn around and continue down the stairs on the right. At the bottom of the stairs stop.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk toward the staircase on the right.
Descend the stairs to the lower level.
Stop when you reach the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: Walk down the hall. Stop outside of the second door on your right.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway.
Pass the first door on your right and continue forward.
Stop outside the second door on your right.

instruction: Walk straight past the table and chairs and out the room using the double doors. Turn right and go through the double doors. Wait near the bottom of the stairs.
plan: Walk straight ahead, passing the table and chairs.
Exit the current room by walking through the double doors.
Turn right.
Walk through the second set of double doors.
Stop and wait near the bottom of the stairs.

instruction: Go down the stairs on the right. Stop at the base where the two stairways meet.
plan: Turn right and approach the stairs on the right.
