Walk straight ahead until you are positioned directly under the subsequent doorway.

instruction: Turn to the left. Walk down the hallway and through the door at the end of the hall. Move through the bedroom. Walk through the door at the left on the end of the bedroom. Stop at the doorway on the inside on the empty room.
plan: Turn left.
Walk down the hallway to the door at the end and go through it.
Continue straight through the bedroom to its far end.
Walk through the left‑hand door at the end of the bedroom.
Stop at the interior doorway of the empty room.

instruction: Turn right and enter the building. Turn left and enter the closest and leftmost doorway. Wait there.
plan: Turn right.
Walk forward and enter the building.
Turn left.
Proceed to the closest leftmost doorway and enter it.
Stop and wait inside the doorway.

instruction: Walk through the door and into the hallway. Continue out into the open room and walk around the banister rail into the room. Walk towards the nearest round table and then continue across the room towards the first set of two chars near against the wall. Continue along the wall to the banister on the other side of the stairwell and stop near the arched doorway.
plan: Walk through the door and enter the hallway.
Continue into the open room and walk around the banister rail into the adjacent room.
Walk to the nearest round table, then proceed across the room toward the first pair of chairs against the wall.
Move along the wall toward the banister on the opposite side of the stairwell.
Stop near the arched doorway.

instruction: Turn around and walk out of the bedroom and into the doorway on the left. Walk straight towards the stairwell. Wait in front of the doorway on the left that is past the stairs.
plan: Turn around to face the bedroom exit.
Walk out of the bedroom and enter the doorway on the left.
Walk straight ahead toward the stairwell.
Continue past the stairs to the doorway on the left.
Stop and wait in front of that doorway.

instruction: You need to leave the bathroom and turn left, then make the go through the first doorway on the left. Now walk straight across the hall and go through that doorway. Next make a left turn and walk past the staircase, stop walking and wait by the entryway to the hall beside the stairs.
plan: Exit the bathroom, turn left, and go through the first doorway on the left.
Walk straight across the hall and go through the next doorway you encounter.
Turn left, walk past the staircase, and stop waiting by the entryway to the hall beside the stairs.

instruction: With the window at your back walk forward into the hallway and take a right. walk across the room and into the hallway on the other side of the room. Stop in the hall outside of the bathroom.
plan: Walk forward into the hallway with the window at your back.
Turn right.
Continue walking straight, crossing the room into the hallway on the other side.
Stop in the hallway outside the bathroom.

instruction: Turn around and walk into the larger hall. Take a left and  stop at the intersection at the end of the hall on the right.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk forward into the larger hall.
Turn left.
Walk straight to the end of the hall.
Stop at the intersection on the right side.

instruction: Walk through the narrow doorway, down the short hallway into the room.  Walk between the two end tables toward the center of the room  Keep walking towards the doorway across the room, between the bed on your right and the dresser on your left.  Walk through that doorway and stop at the entry of the next room.
plan: Walk through the narrow doorway and proceed down the short hallway into the room.
Walk between the two end tables toward the center of the room.
Continue walking toward the opposite doorway, keeping the bed on your right and the dresser on your left.
Walk through that doorway.
Stop at the entry of the next room.

instruction: Turn slightly left and enter the doorway closest to you on the right. Walk towards the blue carpet and turn slightly left again. Enter the middle doorway going outside. Wait there.
plan: Turn slightly left.
Move to the closest doorway on your right and enter it.
Walk straight toward the blue carpet.
Turn slightly left again.
Proceed to the middle doorway, go outside, and wait there.

instruction: Walk around the desk and towards the the door at the far end of the room. Stop off the rug before you leave the room.
plan: Walk around the desk.
Continue straight toward the door at the far end of the room.
Stop just off the rug before exiting the room.

instruction: Stepout of the bathroom and into the hall way and make a right and walk into the foyer and turn right and walk to the end of the stairs and make a left and walk to doorway between the statue of a person with a hat on and the vase and walk though the doorway and wait there.
plan: Exit the bathroom into the hallway and immediately turn right to enter the foyer.
Continue right along the foyer and walk to the end of the stairs.
Turn left and proceed to the doorway located between the statue of a person with a hat and the vase.
Walk through that doorway and stop, waiting there.

instruction: Walk out of the room and to the right of the center table. Walk into the middle doorway and stop.
plan: Walk out of the room.
Walk to the right side of the center table.
Approach the middle doorway.
Walk through the middle doorway.
Stop.

instruction: walk up stairs,  Turn slight right and walk into archway, walk straight down hall to edge of rug.
plan: Walk up the stairs.
Turn slightly right and continue into the archway.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Stop at the edge of the rug.

instruction: Walk into the room and take a left. Go down the hallway and enter the room at the end of the room. Stop once you step onto the rug in the ballroom.
plan: Walk forward into the first room.
Turn left inside that room.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Enter the room at the far end of the hallway.
Stop as soon as your foot lands on the rug in the ballroom.

instruction: Walk into the room with red curtains.  Continue past the bed, and in through the next doorway.  Wait there.
plan: Walk into the room with red curtains.
Walk past the bed.
Enter the next doorway.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Walk down the hall into the large room and turn right. Walk through the center double doors past the table and stop.
plan: Walk down the hall into the large room.
Turn right.
Walk through the center double doors.
Continue past the table.
Stop.

instruction: Walk through the doorway, directly opposite of the window. Turn right after the doorway and walk towards the stair case, walk around the stair case on the farthest door on your left and stop.
plan: Walk straight through the doorway that is directly opposite the window.
Turn right immediately after passing through the doorway.
Continue walking toward the staircase.
Move around the staircase until you reach the farthest door on your left.
Stop at that door.

instruction: Face the bed. Exit through the only door with a rounded arch on the left.Continue through the hallway to the staircase. Pass the staircase on the left and go to the hallway near the railing.
plan: Turn to face the bed.
Walk to the left door with a rounded arch and exit.
Walk straight down the hallway toward the staircase.
Pass the staircase keeping it on your left.
Continue to the hallway near the railing and stop.

instruction: Walk through the doorway in front of you. Once out turn right. Go across the large open room with the rug and enter the door straight in front of you. Once you enter the next room. Stop right before you get to the carpet.
plan: Walk forward through the doorway directly in front of you.
After exiting, turn right.
Walk across the large open room with the rug, proceeding straight toward the door ahead.
Enter the door that is straight in front of you.
Stop right before reaching the carpet in the new room.

instruction: Exit bathroom and turn left into hallway. Turn left at the room with the table in the middle. Walk on the left hand side of the stairs to the archway. Stop at archway.
plan: Exit the bathroom and turn left into the hallway.
Turn left at the room that has a table in the middle.
Walk along the left side of the stairs toward the archway.
Stop at the archway.

instruction: go straight ahead into the room, turn left, go slightly right between two tables, go past the stairs to the right.
plan: Walk straight ahead into the room.
Turn left.
Move slightly right between the two tables.
Continue past the stairs, keeping them on your right.

instruction: Walk out the bathroom and turn right, walking straight towards the staircase. Walk right till you reach the beginning of the staircase, and walk directly straight towards the set of doors to the right of the two gray chairs. Stop when you walk direclty through the doors.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom and turn right.
Continue walking straight toward the staircase until you reach its base.
Walk straight ahead toward the set of doors located to the right of the two gray chairs.
Pass through the doors and stop.

instruction: Exit window room and walk into main room to table in the middle. Walk into doorway to the right of the mirror. Stop before entering empty room.
plan: Walk out of the window room into the main room.
Move toward the table located in the middle of the main room.
Proceed to the doorway that is to the right of the mirror.
Stop just before entering the empty room.

instruction: Head inside and cross the room towards the stairs. Wait near the doorway to the left of the stairs.
plan: Walk straight forward to enter the room.
Continue straight across the room heading toward the stairs.
Stop and wait near the doorway that is to the left of the stairs.

instruction: Walk up stairs. Walk past the round table to the left. Make a hard right after burgundy chair. Wait in threshold of open office door.
plan: Walk up the stairs.
Continue forward, passing the round table on your left.
After the burgundy chair, make a hard right turn.
Proceed to the open office door and stop in its threshold.

instruction: Enter the room with the blue curtains, blue carpet and blue upholstered furniture. Then exit via the double doors to the left. Continue through the passage way until you see a large open staircase towards your left, then head right towards the middle set of doors leading outside. Go through those doors and stop.
plan: Walk to and enter the room with blue curtains, blue carpet, and blue upholstered furniture.
Exit the room via the double doors on the left.
Continue down the passageway until a large open staircase appears on your left.
Turn right and proceed toward the middle set of doors that lead outside.
Go through those doors and stop.

instruction: Go into the nearest doorway and go straight through, make a right and go to the double doors and step outside and wait.
plan: Walk into the nearest doorway.
Continue straight ahead.
Turn right.
Proceed to the double doors and step outside.
Stop and wait outside.

instruction: Walk toward the stair railings and to the top of the stairs heading down.  Do not go down the stairs but rather keep going, turn right, and then walk into the second room on the left.  Stop in the doorway.
plan: Walk straight toward the stair railings and stop at the top of the stairs (do not go down).
Continue moving forward past the stairs.
Turn right.
Walk into the second room on the left and stop in the doorway.

instruction: Walk to the door at the foot of the bed and exit the room. Walk out into the open area and go around the stairs to the door way opposite the bedroom. Stop before entering the hallway.
plan: Walk straight to the door located at the foot of the bed.
Open the door and step out into the open area outside the bedroom.
Walk around the stairs toward the doorway that is opposite the bedroom.
Stop just before crossing the threshold into the hallway.

instruction: Walk into the room on the left. Walk past the table and then walk past the bed. Walk out of the room and wait in the doorway.
plan: Turn left and walk into the room.
Walk forward past the table.
Continue forward past the bed.
Walk out of the room to the doorway.
Stop and wait in the doorway.

instruction: Exit the office and then exit the sitting area. Wait in the hallway between the two doorways.
plan: Walk to the office door and exit the office.
Proceed to the sitting‑area doorway and exit the sitting area.
Stop and wait in the hallway space between the two doorways.

instruction: Wait at the last doorway on the right.
plan: Walk forward along the hallway.
Turn right and continue moving past each doorway.
Stop and wait at the final (last) doorway on the right.

instruction: Take a right and wait in the entrance to the large open room.
plan: Turn right and walk forward to the doorway of the large open room.
Stop and wait at the entrance.

instruction: Leave the bedroom through the arched doorway. Walk through the hallway and into the open area. Stop in front of the balcony straight ahead.
plan: Walk forward and exit the bedroom through the arched doorway.
Continue straight down the hallway.
Enter the open area at the end of the hallway.
Proceed straight ahead toward the balcony.
Stop directly in front of the balcony.

instruction: Walk into the room at the end of the hall and turn right. Walk through the doorway and stop just inside the door.
plan: Walk straight down the hall to the end.
Enter the room located at the end of the hall.
Turn right inside the room.
Walk through the doorway ahead.
Stop just inside the doorway.

instruction: Exit the bathroom and turn left. after you pass an old phone on the wall turn left. Head down that hallway until you get to a large room then turn left. Walk past the stairs and wait near the left side hallway.
plan: Exit the bathroom and turn left onto the hallway.
Continue forward past the old phone on the wall, then turn left.
Walk down the hallway until reaching the large room, then turn left.
Proceed past the stairs.
Stop and wait near the left side of the hallway.

instruction: Walk up the stairs. Walk straight and then enter the first door on your right. Walk straight until you are in the room facing the table on the large rug and stop.
plan: Walk up the stairs to the landing.
Continue walking straight down the hallway.
Enter the first door on your right.
Walk straight into the room until you are facing the table on the large rug.
Stop.

instruction: Head straight and to the left of the tables.  Go the left of the staircase and stop in front of the hall.
plan: Walk straight ahead, keeping the tables on your right side.
Continue forward, staying to the left of the staircase as you pass it.
Stop when you reach the area directly in front of the hall.

instruction: Enter hall and turn left to large room with a table in the middle. Walk across room and enter narrow hallway. Enter empty room and stop after taking 4 steps in.
plan: Walk forward to enter the hall.
Turn left and walk into the large room with a table in the middle.
Walk straight across the room to the opposite side.
Continue forward to enter the narrow hallway.
Enter the empty room and stop after taking four steps inside.

instruction: Leave the office and go into the main room. Take a right and head to the door. Stop once you are on the balcony.
plan: Walk out of the office into the main room.
Turn right.
Walk forward to the door.
Stop when you reach the balcony.

instruction: Exit through the doorway into the hall with a long floor rug and banister railings along the staircase. Walk around the front of the stairwell leading downstairs. Turn the corner around the banister railing and walk into the open door that leads into a large open room with chairs along the wall.
plan: Walk straight through the doorway into the hall with the long floor rug and banister railings.
Move forward, walking around the front of the stairwell as you head downstairs.
Turn the corner around the banister railing.
Enter the open door that leads into the large room with chairs along the wall.

instruction: Go straight and pass all the chairs then turn right and wait by the door that is farthest to the left.
plan: Walk straight ahead, passing all chairs.
Turn right.
Proceed to the door that is farthest to the left.
Stop and wait by that door.

instruction: Go the the left of the table and through the doorway on the left, once in the room turn left and go through the middle doorway on the left side of the room, take a few steps through the doorway and stop.
plan: Walk to the left side of the table.
Go through the doorway on the left.
Turn left after entering the room.
Walk through the middle doorway on the left side of the room.
Take a few steps forward and stop.

instruction: You need to leave the room with the benches and go through the narrow hallway. At the end of the hallway you will walk into a large bedroom. Now make a slight left and go through the doorway at the end of the room. After you go through the doorway wait in the empty room.
plan: Leave the room with the benches.
Walk straight through the narrow hallway until you reach the large bedroom.
Turn slightly left inside the bedroom.
Proceed to the doorway at the far end of the bedroom and go through it.
Stop and wait in the empty room beyond the doorway.

instruction: Turn and walk straight into the large room.  Walk in front of the bed and go to the door that is on the wall, to the left of the bed.  Walk through that door and stop as soon as you enter the next room.
plan: Turn toward the large room and walk straight into it.
Walk forward until you are directly in front of the bed.
Move left along the wall to the door that is to the left of the bed.
Walk through the door.
Stop immediately after entering the next room.

instruction: Enter between the curtains and through the large wooden door. Walk across the room in front of the chaise. Continue past the bed on the right and go through the middle door. Continue down the hall and wait in front of the rail.
plan: Walk between the curtains and pass through the large wooden door.
Walk across the room, staying in front of the chaise.
Continue past the bed on the right and go through the middle door.
Continue down the hall.
Stop and wait in front of the rail.

instruction: Walk forward toward the blue furniture and take a left. In the main room go out of the main door on the right. Stop once you are outside.
plan: Walk forward toward the blue furniture.
Turn left.
Continue straight into the main room.
Exit the main room through the main door on the right.
Stop once you are outside.

instruction: Walk through the door you are facing. Walk straight across the room and through the doorway straight ahead. Stop once you are inside the large open room.
plan: Walk forward through the door you are facing.
Continue straight across the room toward the doorway ahead.
Walk through the forward doorway and stop once inside the large open room.

instruction: Go past the bed and out the middle door then go straight toward the stairs and stop.
plan: Walk forward past the bed.
Exit through the middle door.
Continue straight toward the stairs.
Stop at the stairs.

instruction: Enter the main room with the stairs. Go around the stairs on the left. Go down the hall on the right, and enter the second door on the left. Stop in the doorway.
plan: Enter the main room that contains the stairs.
Walk left, navigating around the stairs.
Turn right and walk down the hallway.
Enter the second door on the left side of the hallway.
Stop in the doorway.

instruction: Go straight toward the two round tables. When you get to the first round table make a right u turn and to into the room your left. Go straight into the room and wait near the bed.
plan: Walk straight toward the two round tables.
When you reach the first round table, turn right and make a U‑turn into the room on your left.
Walk straight into the room.
Stop near the bed and wait.

instruction: Go through the doorway and turn right.  Head through the double doors and stop on the porch.
plan: Walk straight forward through the doorway.
Turn right and continue walking.
Proceed to the double doors.
Walk through the double doors.
Stop on the porch.

instruction: Exit the room, make a right and go straight through the room to the next archway, then take a few steps into the big room and stop.
plan: Walk out of the current room.
Turn right.
Walk straight ahead until you reach the next archway.
Continue a few steps into the big room beyond the archway.
Stop.

instruction: Exit the room. Pass the blue couch and the bed exit that room and head straight out through the hallway. Wait by the top of the stairs.
plan: Walk to the door and exit the room.
Pass the blue couch and the bed while moving toward the hallway.
Continue straight ahead down the hallway.
Stop and wait at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Go out the door on the left then go out the second door on the left and wait there in the hallway.
plan: Walk to and go out the door on the left.
Continue left to the second door and go out through it.
Stop and wait in the hallway.

instruction: Go into the large room with a large rug, and keep going through the room to the door on the other end, into a room with a piano, and wait at the entrance.
plan: Walk into the large room that has the large rug.
Continue straight ahead toward the door on the opposite side of the room.
Pass through that door into the room containing the piano.
Stop and wait at the entrance of the piano room.

instruction: Walk into the the room with the blue furniture. Walk left out of the door and into the room across the hall. Go right and stand just outside the double doors.
plan: Walk forward and enter the room that contains the blue furniture.
Exit that room through the left-hand door and enter the room directly across the hall.
Turn right inside the new room and stop just outside the double doors.

instruction: Follow the blue carpet until you see the stairs going down. Change direction there and move down the stairs. Keep going down the stairs until you reach the fifth stair from the floor. Stand on that fifth stair until you are instructed to move again.
plan: Walk forward while staying on the blue carpet.
When the down‑going stairs appear, turn toward them and step onto the first stair.
Continue walking down the stairs.
Count the steps and stop on the fifth stair above the floor.
Remain standing on that stair until further instructions.

instruction: Look in the direction of the stairs and across to the rightmost arched opening on the opposite side of the stairs. Go through that opening by walking to the left of the stairs. Continue straight through that passage way until you enter a large room. There will be a bed ahead of you and to your left.
plan: Look toward the stairs and identify the rightmost arched opening on the opposite side.
Walk to the left side of the stairs and enter the identified arched opening.
Continue moving straight through the passageway beyond the opening.
Enter the large room at the end of the passage.
Stop in the room, positioning yourself so the bed is ahead and to your left.

instruction: walk away from doorway towards foot of bed, turn right and walk past foot of bed exit bedroom, straight down hallway, stop before banister for stairs.
plan: Walk forward away from the doorway toward the foot of the bed.
Turn right and walk past the foot of the bed to exit the bedroom.
Continue straight down the hallway.
Stop just before the banister leading to the stairs.

instruction: Go straight through the doorway and in to the hallway.  Turn left and go through another door. Cross the room passed the table and enter the doorway on the left. Then continue going straight through another set of doors until you reach a large room.
plan: Walk straight through the first doorway into the hallway.
Turn left and walk through the next door.
Cross the room, passing the table, and enter the doorway on the left.
Continue straight through the following set of doors until you arrive in the large room.

instruction: With a door opening directly behind you and a door to your right and left, move forward into the room ahead of you. Continue to move forward past the open staircase to your left and pass through the double door opening directly ahead of you into the next room.
plan: Walk forward into the room directly ahead.
Continue walking forward, passing the open staircase on your left.
Walk straight ahead through the double‑door opening.
Stop in the next room.

instruction: There is a wall with three doorways. Go stand next to the shelf between the two doorways farthest from you.
plan: Face the wall that has three doorways and determine which two doorways are farthest from you.
Locate the shelf positioned between those two farthest doorways.
Walk straight toward that shelf.
Stop when you are adjacent to the shelf.
Stand next to the shelf.

instruction: Go across the room with the banquet table and wait in the doorway, that is facing another large room.
plan: Walk straight toward the banquet table.
Continue walking across the room, passing the banquet table.
Approach the doorway that opens onto the other large room.
Stop and wait inside the doorway.

instruction: Exit the room and walk down the small hallway with a door on either side.  Walk into the room with a large round table in the middle of it.  Turn left and walk toward the staircase.  Go to the left of the staircase and stop in front of the archway.
plan: Exit the room and walk straight down the small hallway.
Enter the room that contains a large round table in the middle.
Turn left and walk toward the staircase.
Move to the left side of the staircase.
Stop in front of the archway.

instruction: Walk towards the staircase and at the bottom, turn right and walk to the front door.  Go through the door and step outside.
plan: Walk straight toward the staircase.
At the bottom of the staircase, turn right.
Continue walking to the front door.
Go through the front door.
Step outside.

instruction: Turn around until you can see a large wooden round table ahead of you and towards the right. There will be an arched opening directly ahead of you on the opposite wall of the room you're facing. Head towards that opening and go through it until you reach another room through a doorway.
plan: Rotate in place until the large wooden round table appears directly ahead and to the right.
Turn to face the arched opening that is straight ahead on the opposite wall.
Walk forward through the opening until you enter the adjoining room.

instruction: Enter the living room, Walk towards the second door from the left, walk down the hall, and wait by the stairs.
plan: Enter the living room.
Walk to the second door on the left and open it.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Stop and wait by the stairs.

instruction: Turn left to go down the stairs. Wait on the fifth step to the bottom.
plan: Turn left onto the staircase.
Walk down the stairs.
Stop when you reach the fifth step from the bottom.

instruction: Turn left and walk toward the opposite wall. Enter the doorway on the far left of the wall. Wait there.
plan: Turn left.
Walk straight toward the opposite wall.
Enter the doorway located at the far left of that wall.
Stop and wait inside the doorway.

instruction: Walk out the first door on the left. Turn left and walk into the room. Walk past the first table in the center. Turn left and go down the hallway. Walk into the room at the end of the hallway and stop.
plan: Walk out the first door on the left.
Turn left and walk into the next room.
Walk past the first table in the center of the room.
Turn left and proceed down the hallway.
Walk into the room at the end of the hallway and stop.

instruction: Go past the table and chairs and stand close to the middle door.
plan: Walk forward, passing the table and chairs.
Continue straight toward the middle door.
Stop and stand close to the middle door.

instruction: Go through the door and turn right and then walk out the double door to your right. Wait right before the stairs between the two pillars.
plan: Walk straight through the first door.
Turn right.
Proceed to the double doors on the right and walk out through them.
Stop and wait right before the stairs that are situated between the two pillars.

instruction: Walk across room with grey carpet and enter room with red carpet. Stop in doorway.
plan: Walk straight ahead across the room with the grey carpet.
Approach the doorway leading to the red‑carpeted room.
Enter the red‑carpeted room through the doorway.
Stop right inside the doorway.

instruction: Go into the room with the large open staircase ahead of you and to the left. Once inside that room, turn right and head to the center doors on the wall opposite the staircase. Go through those exit doors and stop halfway between the doors and the four pillars ahead of you.
plan: Walk forward and enter the room with the large open staircase on the left.
Turn right once inside the room.
Move straight to the center doors on the wall opposite the staircase.
Pass through the center doors.
Stop at the point halfway between the exit doors and the four pillars ahead.

instruction: Facing the large open staircase, go into the room and veer to the right of the staircase, going through the third arched double door opening on the right.
plan: Walk forward into the room directly ahead of the staircase.
Veer to the right, staying beside the staircase.
Pass the first two arched double doors on the right, counting them.
Continue to the third arched double‑door opening on the right.
Walk through the third door and stop.

instruction: Go inside, turn slight right and start going forward along the left wall, go into the second to last archway then stop.
plan: Walk inside the entrance.
Turn slightly right.
Walk forward along the left wall.
Enter the second‑to‑last archway you encounter.
Stop.

instruction: Go straight and then turn left and go straight toward the round table when you pass the two round tables go out the opening on the right and then stop at the entrance of the room with the blue curtains.
plan: Walk straight ahead.
Turn left and continue walking straight toward the round tables.
Pass the two round tables and exit through the opening on the right.
Proceed to the entrance of the room with the blue curtains.
Stop at that entrance.

instruction: When you are standing at the top of the stairs make a right turn and walk to the hallway beside the other stairs. Next walk to the end of the hall into the doorway of the bedroom and wait.
plan: Turn right.
Walk to the hallway beside the other stairs.
Continue to the end of the hallway.
Enter the bedroom doorway.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Go straight until you go through the round opening and all the way straight until you get to a very large room with green carpet. Wait there.
plan: Walk straight ahead.
Pass through the round opening.
Continue straight until you reach the large room with green carpet.
Stop inside the room and wait.

instruction: Walk out the double doors into the large open room. Go straight across the room and enter the doorway straight across. Once you enter the next room, stop when you reach the rug.
plan: Walk out the double doors into the large open room.
Walk straight ahead across the room toward the opposite doorway.
Enter the doorway that is directly ahead.
Continue forward until you reach the rug.
Stop at the rug.

instruction: Walk through the doorway, turn right into the foyer. Walk through the foyer to the door. Walk out of the door and onto the porch.
plan: Walk through the doorway.
Turn right and enter the foyer.
Walk forward through the foyer to the far door.
Walk through the door.
Step onto the porch.

instruction: Walk through the open door into the next hallway and turn the corner to the left. Walk into the large room with aqua colored floor rugs. Walk around the front of the staircase and walk towards the open door way with a statue of a man on the shelf next to it.
plan: Walk through the open door into the next hallway.
Turn left at the corner and enter the large room with aqua‑colored floor rugs.
Walk around the front of the staircase.
Move toward the open doorway that has a statue of a man on the shelf next to it.
Stop at the doorway.

instruction: Walk around the dining table and stop in front of the credenza furthest to the right.
plan: Walk straight to the dining table.
Circumnavigate the table (move around it) until you are on its far side.
Continue moving rightward toward the credenza that is farthest to the right.
Stop directly in front of that credenza.

instruction: Go into the room with the large blue rug and two round tables in the middle. Go stand outside the doorway to the left of the stairs.
plan: Walk straight to the room with the large blue rug and two round tables in the middle.
Enter the room.
Locate the stairs inside the room.
Move to the doorway that is on the left side of the stairs.
Stand outside that doorway.

instruction: Cross the room and exit through the middle door. Stop near the table in the middle of the room.
plan: Walk straight ahead to the middle of the room.
Stop near the table located in the center.
Continue forward toward the middle door.
Exit the room through the middle door.

instruction: Go downstairs until there's a few stairs left to go and stop.
plan: Walk down the staircase.
Continue until only a few stairs remain.
Stop at that point.

instruction: Walk in front of, and past the stairs. Turn into the last doorway on your right. Stop in the hall with a door on your right and left.
plan: Walk forward, keeping the stairs directly ahead, and continue past them.
Turn right into the last doorway on your right.
Stop in the hall where there is a door on the right and a door on the left.

instruction: Leave the bathroom, and go left. Take the far left and enter the main room. Stop once you are in the this room.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn left and proceed forward.
Continue to the far‑left opening.
Enter the main room.
Stop inside the room.

instruction: Walk forward and make a right towards the chairs. Stay at the center of the huge carpet, and walk forward towards the open door and exit the door. Stand on the tiles outside the door, and stop there.
plan: Walk forward and turn right toward the chairs.
Move to the center of the large carpet and pause.
Walk forward toward the open door.
Exit through the door onto the tiles outside.
Stand on the tiles and stop.

instruction: Exit the room using the middle door on the left. Walk toward the round table straight ahead and wait there.
plan: Locate the middle door on the left side of the room.
Turn toward that door and walk through it to exit the room.
Walk straight ahead toward the round table.
Stop at the round table and wait.

instruction: Walk forward, through the open wooden door. Pivot left and then move forward until you are standing on the white rug. Change direction and move to your right staying on the white rug. Take a left turn and go straight until you reach a doorway. Enter the second doorway from the right and enter the room with pink oriental rug. One step past the doorway, stop here.
plan: Walk forward through the open wooden door.
Pivot left and continue forward until you are standing on the white rug.
Turn right and walk along the white rug.
Turn left, go straight to the doorway, and enter the second doorway on the right into the room with the pink oriental rug.
Take one step past the doorway and stop.

instruction: Go through the near doorway, make a left and go straight, keep left and go passed the stairs and wait.
plan: Walk through the nearby doorway.
Turn left and go straight ahead.
Keep to the left side as you continue moving forward.
Pass the stairs.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Go through the doorway on the right and turn right. Walk over the rug, past the tables and chairs. Continue through the hallway in the top right corner and wait in the doorway of the next room.
plan: Walk through the doorway on the right and immediately turn right.
Walk across the rug, passing the tables and chairs.
Continue forward through the hallway located in the top‑right corner.
Stop and wait in the doorway of the next room.

instruction: Walk across large room to door on right, walk across artifact room and enter large door on the right. Stop between two doors.
plan: Walk straight across the large room toward the door on the right.
Pass through that right‑hand door into the artifact room.
Walk straight across the artifact room toward the large door on the right.
Stop in the space between the two doors (the door you just entered and the large door ahead).

instruction: Turn around and enter the hallway.  Walk though the hallway and enter dining room. Exit the dining to the door on your right. Enter the large bedroom.
plan: Turn around and enter the hallway.
Walk down the hallway and enter the dining room.
Exit the dining room, go to the door on your right, and pass through it.
Enter the large bedroom.

instruction: Turn left in the middle arch. Go straight until you pass two red chairs on the right then turn right and wait near the entrance.
plan: Turn left at the middle arch.
Walk straight forward until two red chairs appear on your right and pass them.
Turn right.
Continue to the entrance area.
Stop and wait near the entrance.

instruction: Walk straight across the open room with the staircase and through the door straight ahead of you. Stop just inside the next room, just before you step on the red rug.
plan: Walk straight ahead across the open room, passing the staircase.
Continue forward through the door directly in front of you.
Stop inside the next room, positioning yourself just before the red rug.

instruction: Walk out of the room and turn right. Go through the middle door on the right. Walk straight and stop at the room with stairs.
plan: Walk out of the room and turn right.
Go through the middle door on the right side.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Stop when you reach the room that contains the stairs.

instruction: Turn left and walk through the small hallway. Once you enter the next room, turn right and go across the room into the door in the middle with a rounded top. Walk to the of the hallway, turn left and stop at the wood railing facing the large open room.
plan: Turn left and walk through the small hallway.
Enter the next room, turn right, and walk across the room to the rounded‑top door in the middle.
Go through that door and walk to the end of the hallway.
Turn left.
Stop at the wood railing facing the large open room.

instruction: Enter the house and angle right, walking close to the chairs on the right side. Continue past the staircase and turn right. Wait in the doorway with the double doors.
plan: Walk through the entrance and angle right, staying close to the chairs on the right side.
Continue forward past the staircase.
Turn right at the end of the hallway.
Stop and wait in the doorway with the double doors.

instruction: Walk towards the bathroom, turn left before reaching it. Go towards the big rug and walk to the left side of the room. Stand in the doorway of the room on the left side of the two chairs next to the big rug.
plan: Walk straight toward the bathroom.
Turn left before reaching the bathroom.
Continue forward toward the big rug.
Move to the left side of the room.
Stop in the doorway on the left side of the two chairs next to the big rug.

instruction: Facing the side of the open staircase, go through the opening on the opposite wall from you and almost all the way to the left.Stop when you reach the four way intersection halfway between the room you just departed and the room ahead.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite wall.
Walk through the opening onto the next space.
Turn left and walk forward almost all the way.
Stop at the four‑way intersection located halfway between the departed room and the room ahead.

instruction: Turn around 160 degrees. Walk straight across the room past the dining table. When you get just past the end of the table, turn slight right, then a quick slight left and continue straight until you are standing in the center of the doorway.
plan: Turn around approximately 160 degrees.
Walk straight forward across the room, passing the dining table.
Just beyond the table’s end, turn slightly to the right.
Immediately make a quick slight left turn to re‑align.
Continue straight ahead and stop at the center of the doorway.

instruction: Go into the large bedroom with a blue rug that has pink flowers on it, and three round tables on the rug. Continue through that room into the room with four windows, all with blue curtains and blue seating areas as a part of the walls just under the windows. Stop right as you enter the room, before the blue rug.
plan: Walk to the doorway of the large bedroom and enter.
Move straight across the bedroom toward the opposite wall.
Pass through the doorway leading to the next room with four windows and blue curtains.
Enter the new room and stop immediately inside, before reaching the blue rug.

instruction: Exit the bathroom and turn left. Go through the door ahead and into the room with quilts on display. Exit the room through the door on the far left. Enter the empty room. Stop there.
plan: Exit the bathroom and turn left.
Walk forward through the door ahead into the room with quilts on display.
Exit that room through the door on the far left.
Enter the empty room beyond that door.
Stop inside the empty room.

instruction: Walk down hall, turn right at intersection into dining room. Turn left and walk into huge sitting room. Wait in center of room.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn right at the intersection and enter the dining room.
Turn left and proceed into the huge sitting room.
Stop and wait in the center of the sitting room.

instruction: Turn left ninety degrees.  There is a large table in front of you.  Walk towards the table.  Stop before you get to the rug.  Turn thirty degrees to your right.  Walk towards the doorway.  Stop in front of the food warming station.  Turn twenty degrees to your left.  Walk straight until the doorway is on your right.  Turn ninety degrees so that you are facing the open doorway.  Walk through the doorway.  Stop when you are halfway down the hall.  There is a large staircase in front of you.
plan: Turn left 90°, walk forward to the large table, and stop before the rug.
Turn right 30°, walk to the doorway and stop in front of the food warming station.
Turn left 20°, walk forward until the doorway is on your right, then turn 90° to face the open doorway.
Walk through the doorway and continue until you are halfway down the hall.
Stop in front of the large staircase.

instruction: Walk across room to exit at double doors. Wait at door to bathroom.
plan: Walk straight across the room toward the double doors.
Pass through the double doors to exit the room.
Stop and wait at the bathroom door.

instruction: Go straight until you get to the room with the large light blue carpet. Continue straight and go into the room next to it with the large pink carpet. Wait there.
plan: Walk forward until you reach the room with the large light‑blue carpet.
Continue straight and enter the next room that has the large pink carpet.
Stop and wait in that room.

instruction: With the window behind you and a solid wall to your right, move forward to exit the room. Upon exiting, turn ninety degrees to the left and move forward. Then turn ninety degrees to the right after entering the room. Move forward past two large circular tables to your left and a display case on your right while walking to the stairs leading downwards. Walk past the stairs with the stairs on your left and stop at the vaulted hallway on your right.
plan: Walk forward to exit the current room.
Turn left 90° and walk forward.
Turn right 90°, then walk forward past two large circular tables on your left and a display case on your right toward the stairs.
Walk past the stairs keeping them on your left and continue toward the vaulted hallway on your right.
Stop at the vaulted hallway.

instruction: Exit the room through the middle doorway, and wait at the table.
plan: Walk straight to the middle doorway and exit the room.
Proceed to the nearest table and stop, waiting there.

instruction: Turn around and head down the hall. Turn left at the table and head towards the other table. Go through the entryway on to the terrace and stop.
plan: Turn around and walk straight down the hall.
Turn left when you reach the table and proceed toward the second table.
Continue forward through the entryway onto the terrace.
Stop at the terrace entrance.

instruction: Turn left and exit the room through the open door.  Enter the great room wait near the stairs on your right.
plan: Turn left.
Walk to the open door and exit the room.
Enter the great room through the doorway.
Stop and wait near the stairs on the right side of the great room.

instruction: Walk through the door towards the glass windows on the far wall. Walk though the open door on the right into the next room. Walk past the glass display case in the middle of the room. Walk through the  open door to the right of the display case into the hallway leading to a large room with blue carpet at the end.
plan: Walk forward through the door toward the glass windows on the far wall.
Turn right and walk through the open door into the next room.
Walk straight past the glass display case in the middle of the room.
Enter the open door on the right side of the display case into the hallway.
Continue down the hallway to the large room with blue carpet at the end.

instruction: Go down the middle hallway on the left if you face the stairs. Go straight and enter the room at the end of the hall. Enter the room through the door on the far right. Stop once you enter the room.
plan: Turn left and enter the middle hallway.
Walk straight down the hallway to its end.
Open and go through the far‑right door of the room at the end.
Stop inside the room.

instruction: Turn around and walk past the table. Wait in front of the large double doors at the end of the table.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk forward, passing the table.
Continue straight until you reach the large double doors at the end of the table.
Stop and wait in front of the doors.

instruction: Walk past the table with the flowers and the bed out of the bedroom. Walk down the hall and stop in front of the railing.
plan: Walk forward past the table with the flowers.
Continue forward past the bed and exit the bedroom.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Stop directly in front of the railing.

instruction: Exit bathroom door to the right of the sink.   Turn left in the hallway, and walk forward to enter the next room.  Enter the room to the left of the large glass center piece.  Wait here.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom door located to the right of the sink.
Turn left when you reach the hallway.
Walk forward in the hallway until you reach the entrance of the next room.
Enter the room that is to the left of the large glass center piece.
Stop and wait in that room.

instruction: face two doors walk through doorway on the left towards old bathroom, turn right before bathroom walk towards carpet, turn left at table and walk through giant doorway and stop when you reach the carpet.
plan: Walk forward through the left doorway of the two doors toward the old bathroom.
Turn right before the bathroom and walk toward the carpet.
Turn left at the table and walk through the giant doorway.
Stop when you reach the carpet.

instruction: Walk to the foot of the bed.  With the foot of the bed to your left, walk straight through the hallway through the middle door.  Stop when you get to the railing.
plan: Walk forward to the foot of the bed.
Turn (if needed) so the foot of the bed is on your left and continue straight down the hallway.
Pass through the middle doorway.
Stop when you reach the railing.

instruction: Turn right and then turn left in the hallway. Turn right at the door and continue to the right of the doorway and stop.
plan: Turn right.
Turn left while walking down the hallway.
At the door, turn right.
Continue moving to the right side of the doorway.
Stop.

instruction: Turn right and proceed along the wall to the open door on your right.  Go through the door and turn right when you get to the glass case.  Proceed through that door and down the hall, stopping right before you get to the end.
plan: Turn right.
Walk along the wall until the open door on the right, then go through the door.
When you reach the glass case, turn right and enter the next door.
Continue down the hall.
Stop right before you reach the end of the hall.

instruction: Turn left and walk through the dining room. Go through the double doors and wait in the hallway.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward through the dining room.
Approach the double doors.
Go through the double doors into the hallway.
Stop and wait in the hallway.

instruction: Go through the door on the right facing the window. Walk straight forward and go through the far left hall. Stop once you enter the hall.
plan: Turn right toward the door that is on the right side when facing the window and go through it.
Walk straight forward down the corridor.
Turn left to move into the far‑left hallway.
Stop immediately upon entering the hallway.

instruction: Facing the glass encasement go straight through the door you're facing, go straight through, keep going straight and take a couple steps onto the rug and stop.
plan: Walk straight forward through the glass encasement door you are facing.
Continue walking straight beyond the door.
Take a couple of steps onto the rug.
Stop.

instruction: Exit dining room to door on the left, walk across large room to first exit on right. stop in hallway with 4 exits.
plan: Turn left and exit the dining room through the left door.
Walk straight across the large room.
Turn right at the first exit on the right side of the large room.
Stop in the hallway that contains four exits.

instruction: Turn left and exit out the door. Walk all the way across the room to the other side. When you reach the windows on the other side, turn left and stop right before you reach the door to exit.
plan: Turn left and go through the door to exit the current area.
Walk straight across the next room until you reach the windows on the far side.
Turn left when you arrive at the windows.
Stop right before the doorway that leads to the exit.

instruction: Turn around and go across the room to the large wooden entry way on the opposite side.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk straight forward across the room.
Stop at the large wooden entryway on the far side.

instruction: Exit the room.  Turn right and go through the arched doorway. Go and stop at the top of the nearest side of the stairs.
plan: Walk to the door and exit the room.
Turn right.
Pass through the arched doorway.
Continue to the nearest side of the stairs and reach the top.
Stop.

instruction: Exit the room. Go straight into the room and turn right. Go into the door in the center and wait in the hallway.
plan: Exit the room.
Walk straight into the adjacent room.
Turn right.
Go through the door in the center.
Stop and wait in the hallway.

instruction: Turn around and walk through the hallway between the windows. Walk down the steps and turn slightly right. Walk across the room and enter the middle doorway. Wait there.
plan: Turn around.
Walk forward through the hallway between the windows.
Walk down the steps and turn slightly right.
Continue across the room and enter the middle doorway.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Enter large lobby and turn left. walk to the end of the room at center through double doors and stop on porch.
plan: Walk forward and enter the large lobby.
Turn left inside the lobby.
Proceed straight to the double doors at the center of the room.
Walk through the double doors onto the porch.
Stop on the porch.

instruction: Exit through the open door and turn left, then proceed into the open room with the carpet.  Turn right and go across the room.  Wait to the right near the top of the stairs.
plan: Walk forward and exit through the open door.
Turn left after exiting.
Enter the open room with the carpet.
Turn right and walk across the room.
Stop to the right near the top of the stairs.

instruction: Turn left and enter the formal study. Walk past the table, turn left and enter the room.  Wait near t he chair.
plan: Turn left and enter the formal study.
Walk forward past the table.
Turn left and enter the adjoining room.
Stop and wait near the chair.

instruction: Turn around and go to the right. Then enter the hallway and turn right to go passed the stairs and the bench. Stop near the archway on the left.
plan: Turn around.
Turn right and walk forward into the hallway.
Turn right within the hallway.
Continue walking past the stairs and the bench.
Stop near the archway on the left.

instruction: With the stairs to your right and you facing the wall with three sets of doors going outside, head towards the doors. Turn left and enter the last vaulted hallway on the wall to your left. Stop at the midpoint of the vaulted hallway between two doors.
plan: Walk straight ahead toward the wall with three sets of doors.
Turn left and enter the last vaulted hallway on the left wall.
Move forward in the vaulted hallway until you reach its midpoint between the two doors.
Stop at that midpoint.

instruction: Go passed the railing to the right and go straight through the room to the left of the room, turn left into the archway passed the chairs and stop when in between the two doorways.
plan: Walk past the railing on the right.
Continue straight through the room on the left.
Turn left into the archway.
Walk past the chairs.
Stop when positioned between the two doorways.

instruction: Walk across to the far side of the corridor, then stop near the stairway on the left and wait.
plan: Walk straight across the corridor to the far side.
Turn left toward the stairway.
Walk forward until you are near the stairway.
Stop next to the stairway.
Wait in place.

instruction: Turn around and walk out the door and into the hallway. In the hallway turn right and enter the large dining room. Turn left and exit the room through the middle of the big doors and stop when you reach the blue rug.
plan: Turn around and walk out the door into the hallway.
Turn right in the hallway and enter the large dining room.
Turn left and exit the dining room through the middle of the big doors.
Stop when you reach the blue rug.

instruction: Turn 80 degrees left. Head towards bed. Enter door next to bed. Stop at banisters.
plan: Turn left by approximately 80 degrees.
Walk straight toward the bed.
Enter the door located next to the bed.
Stop at the banisters.

instruction: Walk down stairs and turn left and walk toward closet door and stop.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Turn left at the bottom of the stairs.
Walk straight toward the closet door.
Stop at the closet door.

instruction: Go straight toward the round table  then turn left and walk outside using the large double doors. Wait there.
plan: Walk straight toward the round table.
Turn left at the round table.
Continue walking to the large double doors and go outside.
Stop and wait at the doorway.

instruction: Go into the room with the big blue rug. Go to the foot of the bed. Go through the open door nearest the foot of the bed. Go to the intersection of hallways and stop.
plan: Walk into the room that has the big blue rug.
Move to the foot of the bed.
Go through the open door closest to the foot of the bed.
Walk to the intersection of the hallways.
Stop at the intersection.

instruction: Go straight and into the door in the middle. Go straight and wait near the round table.
plan: Walk straight ahead to the door located in the middle of the wall.
Open the middle door and pass through it.
Continue walking straight beyond the doorway.
Stop near the round table.

instruction: Enter large lobby, turn left and walk passed stairs going down at the right. Stop in archway at open door.
plan: Walk forward to enter the large lobby.
Turn left inside the lobby.
Walk forward, passing the stairs on your right that go down.
Continue to the archway with the open door.
Stop inside the archway.

instruction: Walk straight until you are on the carpet, then turn left and walk all the chairs on your left and two big table son your right.  You will find a staircase. Use the steps on the right side of the staircase.  Go down the stairs.  Once down the stairs, turn to your right and go down that hallway.  You will see another room with a carpet and lights hanging from the ceiling.
plan: Walk straight until you step onto the carpet, then turn left.
Continue forward keeping chairs on your left and two big tables on your right until you reach the staircase.
Use the steps on the right side of the staircase to go down.
At the bottom, turn right and walk down the hallway.
Stop when you see the room with a carpet and lights hanging from the ceiling.

instruction: Walk to the right side of the room without furniture. Walk through the middle door and onto the rug. Walk to the left side of the stairs and stand in front of the archway next to the stairs.
plan: Walk straight to the right side of the room, staying clear of any furniture.
Go through the middle door and step onto the rug.
Walk toward the left side of the stairs.
Stop in front of the archway that is next to the stairs.

instruction: Go straight then walk toward the round table. After you pass the round table continue straight and go out the door on the left. Wait there.
plan: Walk straight ahead.
Walk toward the round table.
Pass the round table and keep walking straight.
Exit through the door on the left.
Wait at the doorway.

instruction: Go down the stairs. U turn left and go into the room on the right. Wait at the entrance.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Perform a U‑turn to face left.
Turn right and enter the room on the right.
Stop and wait at the room entrance.

instruction: Head out through the main seating area and use the doorway to the far left to pass straight into the bedroom. Wait near the clothed tabled.
plan: Walk forward through the main seating area toward the exit.
Turn left and pass through the doorway at the far left.
Continue straight into the bedroom.
Stop and wait near the clothed table.

instruction: Walk straight all the way down until you get to the third window from the left. Wait there.
plan: Walk straight ahead.
Count windows on your left and continue until you arrive at the third one.
Stop at that window and wait.

instruction: Walk through the narrow doorway between the two glass pane windows. Continue into the next room with a large floor rug and arm chairs around the room. Walk past the couch in the middle and past the music box. Walk through the arched window door in the middle of the wall ahead and stop in the hallway.
plan: Walk through the narrow doorway between the two glass pane windows.
Enter the next room that has a large floor rug and arm chairs.
Walk past the couch in the middle of the room and then past the music box.
Walk through the arched window door in the middle of the wall ahead.
Stop in the hallway.

instruction: Head in and through the office, then use the left doorway to enter the seating area. Stop and wait by the nearest chair.
plan: Walk forward into the office.
Continue straight through the office to its far side.
Turn left and pass through the left doorway into the seating area.
Locate the nearest chair in the seating area.
Stop and wait by that chair.

instruction: Walk toward the staircase and turn right. Walk through the room and right past the chairs. Stop in the hallway.
plan: Walk straight toward the staircase.
Turn right at the staircase.
Walk forward through the room.
Continue turning right and pass the chairs.
Stop in the hallway.

instruction: Exit the intersection towards the staircase, make a right and go straight passed the two chairs on the right, make another right into the intersection and stop in the middle of the intersection.
plan: Exit the intersection heading toward the staircase.
Turn right and walk straight, passing the two chairs on your right.
Turn right into the next intersection.
Stop in the middle of the intersection.

instruction: Turn around and walk across the room with the large carpet. Wait by the bench just before the stairs entrance on the left.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk straight across the room with the large carpet.
Approach the bench located just before the stairs entrance on the left.
Stop and wait by the bench.

instruction: Go straight toward the stairs then turn right. After you pass the stairs turn sharp left. Turn right and go into the double doors. Wait at the entrance.
plan: Walk straight toward the stairs.
Turn right.
After passing the stairs, turn sharp left.
Turn right and go through the double doors.
Stop and wait at the entrance.

instruction: Turn around and exit out the door on your left between the red chairs. Once out turn right and cross the bedroom. Enter the 2nd to the last door on the right and stop in the hallway facing the stairs ahead.
plan: Turn around.
Walk to and exit the door on your left that is between the red chairs.
Turn right and walk across the bedroom.
Enter the second‑to‑last door on the right.
Stop in the hallway, facing the stairs ahead.

instruction: Walk around room with art display, down hallway and stop in the center of big empty room.
plan: Walk around the room that contains the art display.
Exit the room and turn onto the hallway.
Walk down the hallway toward the large empty room.
Enter the big empty room.
Stop in the center of the room.

instruction: Head towards the staircase and turn right. Go past the stairs.  Stop at the archway by the vase.
plan: Walk straight toward the staircase.
Turn right at the staircase.
Continue walking past the stairs.
Stop at the archway by the vase.

instruction: Walk into the great room, turn left and walk to the staircase. Don't descend but go to the right of the stairs and stop.
plan: Walk into the great room.
Turn left and walk to the staircase.
Stop at the base of the stairs without descending.
Move to the right side of the stairs and stop.

instruction: Walk left pas the table and chairs and into the next room and stop.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward past the table and chairs.
Enter the next room.
Stop in the room.

instruction: Walk straight until you get to stairs. Wait near the stairs.
plan: Walk forward until the stairs are visible.
Stop near the stairs and wait.

instruction: Walk down the hallway and onto the large rug. Walk past the large round coffee tables. Turn left at the second coffee table and wait at the first set of doorways.
plan: Walk forward down the hallway onto the large rug.
Continue walking past the large round coffee tables.
Turn left when you reach the second coffee table.
Proceed straight to the first set of doorways.
Stop and wait at the doorway area.

instruction: Turn around, move through the door and into the hallway. Turn left and move forward to through the doorway. Next turn right, walk to the end of the runner and turn left again. Go forward past the stairway, take a left and a quick right into the next door. Wait in that doorway.
plan: Turn around and walk through the door into the hallway.
Turn left and walk forward through the next doorway.
Turn right, walk to the end of the runner, then turn left.
Walk forward past the stairway, turn left, then make a quick right into the following door.
Stop and wait in that doorway.

instruction: Turn left and exit the room out the wood doors. Go across the next room and enter the door to the far left. Walk forward and stop when you reach the large rug.
plan: Turn left and go out the wood doors to leave the current room.
Walk straight across the next room.
Enter the door that is farthest to the left.
Walk forward inside the new room.
Stop when you reach the large rug.

instruction: Turn right and go right toward the stairs. Walk across the room through the middle entryway. Go straight until you reach the room with the chandelier.
plan: Turn right and head toward the stairs.
Walk across the room using the middle entryway.
Continue straight ahead.
Stop when you arrive at the room with the chandelier.

instruction: Walk through the hall into the next room and left around the chairs. Walk through the doorway and right around the desk. Walk through the doorway to the left of the chairs and stop.
plan: Walk forward through the hall into the next room and move left around the chairs.
Walk forward through the doorway and move right around the desk.
Walk forward through the doorway to the left of the chairs and stop.

instruction: Turn slightly right and walk across the carpeted room. Wait by the third window of four counting left to right,.
plan: Turn slightly to the right.
Walk forward across the carpeted room.
Locate the four windows on the wall and count them from left to right.
Stop at the third window.
Wait at that position.

instruction: Exit the room via the arched opening with the double doors at the opposite wall. Continue straight until you step on the carpet ahead and see an open staircase to your left.
plan: Walk straight to the arched opening with the double doors on the opposite wall and exit the room.
Continue walking straight ahead down the hallway.
Keep moving forward until your feet step onto the carpeted area.
Stop when you see the open staircase on your left.

instruction: Turn around and walk to the bottom of the stairs. At the bottom, turn left and then enter the door to your left, right before the white chairs.
plan: Turn around.
Walk straight ahead to the bottom of the stairs.
Turn left at the bottom of the stairs.
Approach the door on the left, stopping right before the white chairs.
Enter the door.

instruction: With the wall that doesn't have any doors on your right, exit through the doorway ahead of you and turn right towards the stairs leading downwards. Continue past the stairs and exit the room through the center archway of the three archways on the opposite wall. Stop once you enter the room at the end of the vaulted hallway.
plan: Walk forward and exit through the doorway ahead.
Turn right and head toward the stairs leading downwards.
Continue straight, passing the stairs.
Exit the room via the center archway of the three archways on the opposite wall.
Stop as you enter the room at the end of the vaulted hallway.

instruction: Walk through the doorway directly left of the blue couch. Then walk through the second doorway, and stop directly in front of where the carpet and the wood floors meet.
plan: Walk to the doorway directly left of the blue couch.
Pass through that doorway.
Continue forward to the second doorway ahead.
Pass through the second doorway.
Stop directly in front of the line where the carpet and wood floors meet.

instruction: Go to your right and then enter the door. Turn right again and follow the wall all the way to the doorway on the far right. Then turn right and stop in the hallway.
plan: Turn right and approach the door.
Enter the doorway.
Turn right and walk along the wall until you reach the far‑right doorway.
Turn right into the hallway.
Stop.

instruction: Leave the hallway and enter the room with the dome. Take a left at the dome. Stop once you are in the large empty room.
plan: Walk out of the hallway into the room that contains the dome.
Turn left at the dome.
Continue straight until you enter the large empty room.
Stop.

instruction: Turn hard right to exit the room through the arched hallway. Then turn right to walk through the corridor. Just before the stairs veer right and wait in the arched entryway.
plan: Turn hard right and walk through the arched hallway to leave the room.
Turn right onto the corridor and continue forward.
