instruction: Turn to the left and walk past the white chair. Turn right and walk past the double doors into the doorway. Walk in the hallway past the wooden cabinets. Enter the bedroom to your left and stop.
plan: Turn left and walk past the white chair.
Turn right and walk through the double doors into the doorway.
Continue walking down the hallway past the wooden cabinets.
Enter the bedroom on your left.
Stop.

instruction: Go straight and slightly right. Continue down the hallway until you get to stairs on the right. Go up six steps then stop.
plan: Walk straight ahead while veering slightly to the right.
Continue down the hallway until the stairs appear on the right side.
Turn right onto the staircase.
Ascend six steps.
Stop at the top of the sixth step.

instruction: Walk straight ahead and into the room on the right. Wait at the stairs.
plan: Walk straight ahead down the hallway.
Turn right and enter the room on the right.
Continue forward inside the room until reaching the stairs.
Stop and wait at the stairs.

instruction: Go downstairs and turn left. Entering the small room with the phone, veer left towards the small statue in the alcove. Stop inside the last door on the left, which contains a plunge pool with a painted sky.
plan: Walk downstairs.
Turn left after reaching the lower level.
Enter the small room that contains the phone.
Veer left toward the small statue in the alcove.
Stop inside the last door on the left, where the plunge pool with a painted sky is located.

instruction: Keep walking forward, and turn left when the flower picture frame is visible on the wall to your right. Walk towards the bedroom, and enter inside, and stop there.
plan: Walk straight ahead until the flower picture frame is visible on the right wall.
Turn left.
Continue walking toward the bedroom.
Enter the bedroom.
Stop inside the bedroom.

instruction: Make a left and head forward toward the staircase, slight right toward staircase, then wait on second stair.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward toward the staircase.
Adjust slightly right while continuing toward the staircase.
Ascend to the second stair.
Stop and wait on the second stair.

instruction: Exit the bathroom. Walk straight until you see two silver vases straight ahead then turn left. Wait near the white door with the glass decoration. Wait there.
plan: Exit the bathroom.
Walk straight ahead down the corridor.
When you see two silver vases directly ahead, turn left.
Proceed to the white door that has a glass decoration.
Stop and wait near that door.

instruction: From the top of the stairs go counter clockwise around the hallway. Go through the first door on the right and stop next to the bed in front of the double doors.
plan: Walk from the top of the stairs and move counter‑clockwise around the hallway.
Continue until you reach the first door on your right.
Open and go through that door.
Proceed toward the bed that is positioned in front of the double doors.
Stop next to the bed.

instruction: Walk past the stairs and download hall. Stop near the alcove that leads outdoors.
plan: Walk forward past the stairs.
Continue walking down the hall.
Stop near the alcove that leads outdoors.

instruction: Exit the bedroom. Turn right.Go down the hallway until you get to a room. Wait near the bed.
plan: Walk out of the bedroom.
Turn right.
Walk straight down the hallway until you reach a room.
Stop and wait near the bed.

instruction: With the display case on your right, move forward in the corridor, turning to the right to follow it. At the base of the stairs leading upwards, go through the door that's to the right of the stairs. Turn forty-five degrees to the left and continue past a small mirror to your right. Then enter the room on your right with the wooden flooring.
plan: Walk forward down the corridor, keeping the display case on your right and turn right to follow it.
At the base of the upward stairs, enter the door located to the right of the stairs.
Turn forty‑five degrees to the left.
Walk past the small mirror that is on your right.
Enter the room on your right that has wooden flooring.

instruction: Enter the hallway on the left with the stairs. Proceed past the art niche, then turn right into the dining room. Wait on the rug by the table.
plan: Turn left and enter the hallway that contains the stairs.
Walk forward until you pass the art niche.
Turn right to enter the dining room.
Stop and wait on the rug near the dining table.

instruction: Leave the room, and take a left. Go straight down the hallway, and follow it as it curves. Stop in front of the closet before you reach the stairs.
plan: Leave the room.
Turn left.
Walk forward down the hallway, following its curve.
Continue until you see the closet that is before the stairs.
Stop in front of the closet.

instruction: Walk straight for a moment and then take a slight left and walk towards the open door, make a hard left and then continue into the room with the long table and stop.
plan: Walk straight ahead for a short distance.
Turn slightly left and walk toward the open door.
Make a hard left turn entering the doorway.
Continue forward into the room with the long table.
Stop in the room near the long table.

instruction: Walk through the doorway to the left of the fireplace, Walk right down the hallway, and walk into the first room on your left. Stop before you reach the small carpet.
plan: Walk straight through the doorway located to the left of the fireplace.
Turn right and walk down the hallway.
Turn left and enter the first room on your left.
Stop just before reaching the small carpet.

instruction: Continue up the stairs and turn left into the hall. Turn into the first bedroom on the right and stop next to the nightstand with a telephone on it.
plan: Walk up the stairs to the next landing.
Turn left and enter the hallway.
Turn right into the first bedroom on the right side of the hallway.
Stop next to the nightstand that has a telephone on it.

instruction: Turn around and walk down the hallway and out the door at the end, across from the stairs. Once out, turn left and walk across the foyer area to the stairs. Start up the stairs and stop once you get to the 2nd step.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk down the hallway and exit through the door at its end, which is across from the stairs.
Turn left in the foyer area and walk straight to the base of the stairs.
Begin ascending the stairs and stop when you reach the second step.

instruction: Go up the right staircase and stop once you reach the top.
plan: Locate and approach the right staircase.
Walk onto the staircase and begin ascending.
Continue climbing the stairs to the top floor.
Stop at the top landing of the staircase.

instruction: Walk through the living room area passed the chairs. Walk through the open double doors and into the entry room with red carpet. Walk up to the stairwells.
plan: Walk forward through the living room, passing the chairs.
Continue through the open double doors into the entry room with the red carpet.
Walk straight ahead to the stairwells and stop there.

instruction: Walk down the hall that curves left. Stop by the flower painting.
plan: Walk forward into the hallway that curves to the left.
Continue down the hallway until you see the flower painting.
Stop beside the flower painting.

instruction: Leave the dressing room, and go right. Go to the stairwell on the right. Stop on the second stair from the bottom.
plan: Walk out of the dressing room.
Turn right and move down the hallway.
Continue straight to the stairwell on the right.
Approach the stairwell entrance.
Step onto the second stair from the bottom and stop.

instruction: Turn around and walk down the hallway. Head past the iron railing and into the bedroom. Wait just inside the bedroom.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Continue past the iron railing.
Enter the bedroom.
Stop and wait just inside the bedroom.

instruction: Walk past the steps into the hallway. Turn right into the dining room. Stop on the black and white striped rug.
plan: Walk forward past the steps to enter the hallway.
Turn right to go into the dining room.
Stop on the black and white striped rug.

instruction: Walk past fireplace. Walk past chandelier. Walk past fireplace. Wait at double doors.
plan: Walk forward past the fireplace.
Continue walking forward past the chandelier.
Walk forward past the fireplace again.
Proceed to the double doors.
Stop and wait at the double doors.

instruction: Exit room through the doorway near the fireplace. Keep right and walk through the hallway, turn right, enter the bedroom and wait near the bed.
plan: Walk through the doorway near the fireplace to exit the room.
Keep right and proceed straight down the hallway.
Turn right at the hallway intersection.
Enter the bedroom through the door on the right.
Stop and wait near the bed.

instruction: leave sitting room, jump the ropes and stop at top of stairs looking toward chandelier.
plan: Walk out of the sitting room.
Go to the rope area and jump the ropes.
Continue to the top of the stairs.
Stop at the top of the stairs.
Turn to look toward the chandelier.

instruction: Walk forward with the fireplace on your left. Go over the velvet rope and walk towards the ornate doors. Stop at the doors with the fireplace poker on your left.
plan: Walk forward, keeping the fireplace on your left.
Step over the velvet rope.
Continue walking toward the ornate doors.
Stop at the doors, ensuring the fireplace poker remains on your left.

instruction: Turn to the left and climb over the rope.  Go down the hallway.  Jump over the rope on the right side at the end of the hallway.  Wait right there by the fireplace.
plan: Turn left and climb over the rope.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Jump over the rope on the right side at the end of the hallway.
Stop and wait by the fireplace.

instruction: Go straight down the hallway. Turn slightly right to continue going straight down the hallway. When you get to stairs on the right turn left. Turn right and go into the room on the right. Wait near the couches.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway.
Slightly turn right and keep walking straight.
When the stairs appear on the right, turn left.
Turn right and enter the room on the right.
Stop and wait near the couches.

instruction: Walk through the open doors with golden decorations. Walk through the next room passed the ceiling lamp towards the grandfather clock up against the wall. Walk through the door to the left of the clock and into the next room that has glass chandeliers and wrap around Victorian couches.
plan: Walk through the open doors with golden decorations.
Continue into the next room, pass the ceiling lamp, and head toward the grandfather clock against the wall.
Turn left at the clock and walk through the door on its left.
Enter the room that contains glass chandeliers and wrap‑around Victorian couches.
Stop in that room.

instruction: Turn right and head out into the room with the three leaf decoration on the wall, pass the decoration on its right, go through the doorway and up the stairs, stop at the third step before the top facing the three piece picture.
plan: Turn right and walk toward the room with the three‑leaf decoration on the wall.
Pass the three‑leaf decoration keeping it on your right side.
Continue through the doorway into the staircase.
Ascend the stairs and stop at the third step before the top.
Face the three‑piece picture.

instruction: Walk to the staircase that curves to the left. Walk up the stairs and stop at the third step from the top.
plan: Walk straight ahead until you reach the staircase that curves to the left.
Turn left and step onto the staircase entrance.
Ascend the stairs, moving upward step by step.
Stop when you reach the third step below the topmost step.

instruction: Go around the table and head towards stairs that lead down. Walk a little forward towards the chandelier and wait at the stairs before going down.
plan: Walk around the table.
Head toward the stairs that lead down.
Walk a little forward toward the chandelier.
Stop at the stairs and wait.

instruction: Walk up the stairs and turn left. Go down the hallway and enter the first door on your right leading to a bedroom. Stand by the double doors left of the bed.
plan: Walk up the stairs and turn left at the landing.
Walk down the hallway.
Enter the first door on your right that leads to a bedroom.
Stand beside the double doors that are to the left of the bed.

instruction: Make a right from the door facing the gold couch and go down the long narrow hallway. Go down the hall until you see a room with steps then make a right so you in front of the door on the right side of the room. Go through that door and wait by the big mirror and fireplace.
plan: Turn right at the door that is opposite the gold couch.
Walk straight down the long narrow hallway.
Continue until you see a room with steps, then turn right to stop in front of the door on the right side of that room.
Open and go through that door.
Stop and wait by the big mirror and fireplace.

instruction: Walk down the hall and turn left into the first doorway. Continue past the stairs and turn left. Turn right into the dining room. Wait just inside the entrance on the corner of the rug.
plan: Walk straight down the hall.
Turn left and enter the first doorway.
Continue forward past the stairs and turn left.
Turn right into the dining room.
Stop just inside the entrance on the corner of the rug.

instruction: Go past the ropes and go straight down the red carpet and past the stairs on your left. Go into the sitting room through the door on your right straight ahead and stop once you pass the doors.
plan: Walk forward, passing the ropes.
Continue straight along the red carpet, passing the stairs on your left.
Enter the sitting room through the door on your right that is straight ahead.
Stop once you have passed the doors inside the sitting room.

instruction: Walk out the door left of the second fire place, then ascend the stairs to the right and wait on the top step between the winding stair cases.
plan: Walk to the door that is left of the second fireplace and exit it.
Turn right toward the staircase and begin ascending.
Continue up the stairs until you reach the top step.
Position yourself between the two winding staircases on the top step and wait.

instruction: exit room and walk through room, stop between doorways on right.
plan: Walk to the door and exit the current room.
Continue walking straight forward into the adjacent area.
Proceed forward until you see two doorways on your right.
Stop at a point equidistant between those two right‑hand doorways.

instruction: Make left at candelabra floor lamp. Walk past fire extinguisher. Walk up white marble steps. Make right at top of marble stair landing. Wait on second step from bottom.
plan: Turn left at the candelabra floor lamp.
Walk forward past the fire extinguisher.
Ascend the white marble stairs.
Turn right at the top of the marble stair landing.
Stop on the second step from the bottom.

instruction: Turn right to leave room. Walk past the stairs. Turn left down the hall. Turn at the doorway just past the statuette on the right. Stop on the closest corner of the black and white rug.
plan: Turn right and leave the room.
Walk forward past the stairs.
Turn left onto the hallway.
Turn at the doorway just beyond the statuette on the right.
Stop at the closest corner of the black and white rug.

instruction: Walk past round mirror. Make hard left at rectangular mirror. Walk past fire extinguisher. Wait at top of marble stairs.
plan: Walk forward until the round mirror is passed.
Turn hard left at the rectangular mirror.
Continue walking forward past the fire extinguisher.
Stop and wait at the top of the marble stairs.

instruction: turn left and walk towards opening on the right. Enter large hall. turn left towards short stairs. Go up short staircase and stop at the top between another set of stairs.
plan: Turn left and walk toward the opening on the right.
Enter the large hall through the opening.
Turn left toward the short stairs.
Ascend the short staircase.
Stop at the top, positioned between the next set of stairs.

instruction: Turn around and head up the hallway and go past the dining room. Make a right turn and go through the open door at the foot of the stairs. Make a left and go through the large arch past the silver mirror. Wait at the corner of the couch.
plan: Turn around and walk up the hallway, passing the dining room.
Turn right and go through the open door at the foot of the stairs.
Turn left and go through the large arch past the silver mirror.
Stop and wait at the corner of the couch.

instruction: Go straight and turn right. You can see near pillars and upstairs.
plan: Walk straight ahead until you reach the pillars.
Turn right at the pillars.
Proceed to the staircase and ascend the stairs.
Stop at the landing after going upstairs.

instruction: Walk under the chandelier and up the marble steps.  Stop in between the base of the two red staircases.
plan: Walk forward to reach the chandelier.
Continue walking to pass directly under the chandelier.
Proceed upward onto the marble steps.
Move toward the area where the two red staircases begin.
Stop in the space between the bases of the two red staircases.

instruction: TUrn around, walk on the red runner, go past the fireplace.  Stop when you get to the 3 chairs.  wait there.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk forward staying on the red runner.
Continue walking until you pass the fireplace.
Stop when you reach the three chairs.
Wait at the chairs.

instruction: Go left through the second door by the columns, then enter the next room and turn right, wait by the table.
plan: Turn left and walk through the second door located by the columns.
Enter the room immediately beyond the door.
Turn right inside the room.
Walk toward the table.
Stop and wait by the table.

instruction: Walk around the two chairs to the right and step over the rope barrier. Walk down the hallway to the right and wait in the sitting room near the round table.
plan: Walk right, circling the two chairs.
Step over the rope barrier.
Turn right and walk down the hallway.
Enter the sitting room and approach the round table.
Stop and wait near the round table.

instruction: walk forward through the ornate double doors and into the hallway In the hall walk forward and go into the sitting room on the left. Stop in the doorway to the sitting room.
plan: Walk forward through the ornate double doors into the hallway.
Continue walking straight down the hallway.
Turn left and enter the sitting room.
Stop in the doorway of the sitting room.

instruction: Turn around and go past the two chairs.  Jump the rope.  And then go straight on down the runner rug.  Turn left at the marble staircase and go to the top of that.  Then wait.
plan: Turn around and walk past the two chairs.
Jump the rope.
Continue straight down the runner rug.
Turn left at the marble staircase and go to the top of it.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Take first left through doorway, walk straight down red carpet, stop between the two large pillars on left side.
plan: Turn left and go through the first doorway.
Walk straight forward along the red carpet.
Stop between the two large pillars on the left side.

instruction: Enter siting room and walk straight across it passing chairs and table. turn right following rope.Turn left at open door. Enter through double doors and stop in the middle of the room beside chairs.
plan: Enter the sitting room.
Walk straight across the room, passing the chairs and table.
Turn right and follow the rope.
Turn left at the open door and go through the double doors.
Stop in the middle of the next room, beside the chairs.

instruction: Exit the room by going through the doorway on the left. Go straight and stop at the top of the stairs.
plan: Walk to the doorway on the left and go through it to exit the room.
Continue walking straight ahead down the hallway.
Stop when you reach the top of the stairs.

instruction: Follow the couch round the table and out the door on the right side of the room. Walk up the stairs to the left and hold on the landing between the winding staircases.
plan: Walk around the couch toward the table, then continue straight to the door on the right side of the room and go out.
Turn left and approach the staircase on the left.
Ascend the left staircase.
Stop on the landing that lies between the two winding staircases.

instruction: Pass the fireplace and then go straight out the door ahead. Wait by the chairs that have flowers.
plan: Walk forward past the fireplace.
Continue straight to the door ahead.
Exit through the door.
Move to the chairs that have flowers.
Stop and wait by those chairs.

instruction: Walk around the big roped off display and turn left. Go through that entryway and down that hallway. Stop by the other roped off display on your right.
plan: Walk around the big roped‑off display and turn left.
Enter the entryway ahead.
Walk down the hallway.
Stop beside the other roped‑off display on your right.

instruction: With the fireplace towards your right side, enter the room ahead and exit the next room via the rightmost opening on the opposite wall. Continue forward until the carpet ends, then go past the rope barrier to your right and wait on the carpet to the right of the fireplace.
plan: Walk forward into the room ahead, keeping the fireplace on your right.
Exit the next room through the rightmost opening on the opposite wall.
Continue straight ahead until you reach the end of the carpet.
Move past the rope barrier on your right side.
Stop and wait on the carpet area to the right of the fireplace.

instruction: Walk up to the entrance of the staircase in the middle. Go up the stairs 4 steps. Go to the middle of the entrance of the staircase and wait.
plan: Walk straight to the entrance of the staircase located in the middle of the area.
Ascend the staircase for four steps.
Walk back down (or move) to the middle of the staircase entrance.
Stop and wait at that position.

instruction: Walk into the hallway with the red rug. Once out of the walkway turn right and go through the door closest to the two main doors. Wait at the entrance to that room.
plan: Walk forward into the hallway that has the red rug.
Continue to the end of the walkway and exit onto the next area.
Turn right.
Walk to the door closest to the two main doors and go through it.
Stop and wait at the entrance of the room.

instruction: Turn right and walk along the red carpet into the next room past the chairs and wait between both entrances.
plan: Turn right.
Walk forward along the red carpet.
Continue into the next room, passing the chairs.
Stop and wait in the space between the two entrances.

instruction: Walk up the red stairs. Stop where the stairs come to a break.
plan: Locate the red stairs.
Walk straight up the red stairs.
Continue until you reach the break (landing or gap) in the stairs.
Stop at the break.

instruction: Walk out of the sitting area and go the stairs. Go down one stair to the second from the top and stop.
plan: Walk straight out of the sitting area toward the doorway.
Continue straight to reach the stairwell entrance.
Descend one stair step (to the second‑from‑top step) and stop.

instruction: Exit the room, walk down the hallway to the left next to the striped chair, wait at the door by the fire extinguisher.
plan: Exit the room.
Turn left and walk down the hallway, staying next to the striped chair.
Stop at the door beside the fire extinguisher and wait.

instruction: Turn left just before the roped off section with table and chairs. Walk into the doorway on the right. Wait next to the table and chairs.
plan: Walk forward until you are just before the roped‑off section with the table and chairs.
Turn left.
Continue straight and walk into the doorway on the right.
Move to stand next to the table and chairs.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Turn left and then wait next to the fire place on the right.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward until the fireplace appears on your right.
Stop and wait next to the fireplace.

instruction: Walk through the doors and into the hallway with a red floor rug. Walk down the hall into the open door ahead long the red floor rug. Walk up the small set of marble steps through the door. Walk up the steps up the right stairwell and stop on the stairs.
plan: Walk through the doors into the hallway with the red floor rug.
Continue down the hall along the red rug to the open door ahead.
Enter the open door and walk up the small set of marble steps.
Proceed up the right stairwell.
Stop on the stairs.

instruction: Walk through the double doors and turn left. Continue through another set of double doors. Wait in front of the circle railing in front of the stairs and between the large columns.
plan: Walk forward through the first set of double doors.
Turn left.
Walk forward through the second set of double doors.
Proceed to the circular railing positioned between the large columns in front of the stairs.
Stop and wait there.

instruction: Follow the long red rug and leave the sitting room. walk froward in the open area and take a right at the end of the roped off seating area and stand on the red rug behind the sitting area before you reach the doorway into the next room/.
plan: Follow the long red rug to exit the sitting room.
Walk straight ahead in the open area.
When you reach the end of the rope‑off seating area, turn right.
Continue forward onto the red rug located behind the sitting area.
Stop on the rug before reaching the doorway to the next room.

instruction: Turn toward the exit past the ropes.  Walk out of the exit doors down the red carpet.  Stop facing the stairs.
plan: Turn toward the exit past the ropes.
Walk through the exit doors onto the red carpet.
Continue walking down the red carpet toward the stairs.
Stop and face the stairs.

instruction: Walk across sitting room to hallway that is to the right of the fireplace. Turn left towards stairs, stop at top step between two pillars.
plan: Walk straight across the sitting room toward the hallway located to the right of the fireplace.
Turn left and move toward the stairs.
Stop at the top step positioned between the two pillars.

instruction: Walk forward throuhg the sitting room passing the fireplace with the sitting area on your left to exit the room. Out of the room take a right and go  up the marble stairs. Stop on the top of the marble stairs next tot he left pillar.
plan: Walk straight forward through the sitting room, passing the fireplace with the sitting area on your left, until you reach the doorway.
Turn right as you exit the room.
Walk up the marble stairs.
Stop at the top of the stairs beside the left pillar.

instruction: Travel straight through the large ornate room and through the double door with the golden wreath located on it and continue on until you see a large crystal chandelier.
plan: Walk forward into the large ornate room.
Continue straight to reach the double doors with the golden wreath.
Pass through the double doors.
Keep moving straight ahead until the large crystal chandelier becomes visible.
Stop at the chandelier.

instruction: Turn left and follow the rope. At the end of the rope turn right and follow the rope to the left. Once you enter that room, stop right before the table in the middle.
plan: Turn left and walk forward while staying beside the rope.
Continue until the rope ends, then turn right.
Follow the rope that leads left into the next area.
Enter the room at the end of the rope.
Stop just before the table positioned in the middle of the room.

instruction: Walk across room to hallway on left follow red rug to two large pillars and turn left. Stop at top of steps.
plan: Walk straight across the room toward the hallway on the left.
Enter the left hallway and follow the red rug forward.
Continue until you reach the two large pillars.
Turn left at the pillars.
Stop at the top of the steps.

instruction: Walk toward the long table and turn left to go through the open double doors.  Go through that doorway and turn right to go down another hallway.  Walk forward until you reach the marble stairs and walk up those stairs.  Go to the staircase on the right and stop on the second stair.
plan: Walk toward the long table and turn left to pass through the open double doors.
Enter the doorway, turn right, and walk down the hallway until you reach the marble stairs.
Walk up the marble stairs.
Move to the staircase on the right.
Stop on the second stair of that staircase.

instruction: Walk down hallway to large entry way, walk into right hand entry and stop at fireplace.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway until you reach the large entryway.
Turn right to face the right-hand entry.
Walk forward into the right-hand entry.
Stop at the fireplace.

instruction: Exit the sitting area through the second set of doors on the right. Walk down the hall and wait in the room to the left, next to the wardrobe.
plan: Turn right and walk past the first set of doors, then go through the second set of doors to exit the sitting area.
Walk straight down the hall.
Turn left and enter the room on the left side of the hall.
Move to the spot next to the wardrobe.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Turn left and walk along the red carpet. Enter the rightmost doorway behind the chairs. Wait by the small table in the middle of the chairs.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward along the red carpet.
Enter the rightmost doorway that is behind the chairs.
Stop and wait by the small table situated in the middle of the chairs.

instruction: Walk away from the semi circle of chairs through the doorway, follow the red carpet to the left, pass the fire extinguisher on your left and follow the red carpet until there is a staircase on your right. Stop at the top.
plan: Walk forward through the doorway, moving away from the semi‑circle of chairs.
Turn left and follow the red carpet.
Continue past the fire extinguisher that is on your left.
Keep following the red carpet until a staircase appears on your right.
Ascend and stop at the top of the staircase.

instruction: With the round table behind you walk out of the room and take a left. walk on the red rug down the hall and out of the room into the foyer. In the foyer walk up the marble stairs, and stop on the second stair from the bottom on the right staircase.
plan: Walk out of the room, keeping the round table behind, and turn left.
Step onto the red rug, walk down the hall, and exit into the foyer.
In the foyer, locate the right marble staircase and begin ascending.
Stop on the second stair from the bottom of that staircase.

instruction: Facing the fireplace leave the room through the door on the right of the fireplace. Walk to the stairs, and stop at the top of the stairs.
plan: Face the fireplace.
Turn right and leave the room through the door on the right of the fireplace.
Walk straight toward the stairs.
Ascend the stairs.
Stop at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Turn left and go down the hallway and turn right then go down that hall until you get to a candy cane striped chair. Head up the four steps on the left and then go up two steps on the right and stop there.
plan: Turn left and walk down the hallway.
Turn right and continue down that hallway until you reach the candy‑cane striped chair.
Ascend the four steps on the left side of the chair.
Ascend the two steps on the right side.
Stop.

instruction: Turn around so that you are facing the chandelier. Take your first right. Stop at the end of the hallway. Turn right. Stop in front of the coffee table.
plan: Turn around until you are facing the chandelier.
Take the first right turn.
Continue to the end of the hallway and stop.
Turn right.
Stop in front of the coffee table.

instruction: Walk straight ahead past the reg rug. Walk up the marble stairs. Stand between the two sets of red stairs.
plan: Walk straight ahead until you pass the rug.
Continue forward onto the marble stairs and walk up them.
Stop in the area positioned between the two sets of red stairs.

instruction: Walk from sitting room to long red rug. Turn left and walk straight to stairs on left. Turn left and walk up steps and stop.
plan: Walk from the sitting room to the long red rug.
Turn left and walk straight toward the stairs on the left.
Turn left to face the staircase.
Walk up the steps.
Stop at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Turn right and go up the marble stairs. Then take the red carpeted stairs to the right. Wait on the landing.
plan: Turn right.
Walk up the marble stairs.
Turn right onto the red carpeted stairs.
Ascend the red carpeted stairs to the landing.
Stop and wait on the landing.

instruction: Enter the right room next to the fire extinguisher and stop at the stanchions.
plan: Walk to the fire extinguisher and face the right side of it.
Turn right and enter the adjacent room.
Move forward toward the stanchions.
Stop at the stanchions.

instruction: Walk past the fireplace and out of the room. Walk under the chandelier and stop.
plan: Walk forward past the fireplace.
Continue forward to leave the room.
Move toward the chandelier.
Walk under the chandelier.
Stop.

instruction: Walk past the column and then in front of the table and chairs to the right. Continue through the left double door and wait in the middle of the long, red rug.
plan: Walk forward past the column.
Turn right and walk in front of the table and chairs.
Continue straight through the left double door.
Stop and wait in the middle of the long red rug.

instruction: Go through the door into a hall down a red carpet.  When you get to another doorway with a striped chair and mirror on either side, stop.
plan: Walk through the door into the hall.
Walk straight down the hall on the red carpet.
Continue until you reach the doorway that has a striped chair and a mirror on either side.
Stop at that doorway.

instruction: Exit the room through the doorway on the same wall as the mirror. In the next room there is a large empty rectangular table in the middle. Stand on the far side of it, between it and the two chairs.
plan: Walk to the doorway on the same wall as the mirror and go through it.
Enter the next room and look for the large empty rectangular table in the middle.
Move toward the far side of the table, away from the entrance.
Position yourself between the table and the two chairs, then stop.

instruction: Stand with the ropes to your left and behind you and walk straight into the next room.  Walk past the marble columns and go through the doorway of the right, closest to the windows.  Stop after passing through this doorway and are near the fireplace.
plan: Stand facing forward with the ropes positioned to your left and behind you.
Walk straight ahead into the adjacent room.
Continue forward, passing the marble columns.
Enter the doorway on the right side that is closest to the windows.
Stop once you have passed through the doorway and are near the fireplace.

instruction: Walk down the right side of the hallway. Enter through the doorway on the right. Continue walking straight. Turn right and stop at the entrance of the room next to the rope partition.
plan: Walk down the right side of the hallway.
Enter the doorway on the right.
Continue walking straight ahead.
Turn right.
Stop at the entrance of the room next to the rope partition.

instruction: Walk into the room with the double staircase.  Walk up the stairs on the right and stop where the two staircases connect at the foot of the single staircase.
plan: Walk into the room that contains the double staircase.
Identify and approach the staircase on the right side of the double staircase.
Walk up the right staircase.
Continue upward until you reach the junction where the two staircases connect to the single staircase at its foot.
Stop at that junction.

instruction: Step onto the red carpet and turn left. Walk down the red carpet, following the roped off section, and turn right after the rope ends. Follow the red carpet forward and turn left, walking through the double doors. Walk forward and wait near the chairs.
plan: Step onto the red carpet and turn left.
Walk along the roped‑off portion of the carpet, then turn right when the rope ends.
Continue forward on the carpet, turn left, and walk through the double doors.
Walk forward inside the room and stop near the chairs.

instruction: Exit the pink room using the left door then head out to the hallway and walk until you get to the top of the stairs on the left. Wait there.
plan: Open the left door of the pink room and step outside.
Walk straight into the hallway.
Continue forward, keeping the stairs on your left, until you reach the top of the stairs.
Stop and wait at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Turn to the left, stepping over the red velvet rope and onto the first red rug, then turn left. Head down the hallway until you see a red and white striped chair on your left. Head up the grey stairs until you're standing on the first red tile mosaic, and wait there.
plan: Turn left and step over the red velvet rope onto the first red rug.
Turn left and walk down the hallway until a red‑and‑white striped chair is on your left.
Continue up the grey stairs until you stand on the first red tile mosaic.
Stop and wait there.

instruction: Go down the hallway.  Turn left and head up the stairs.  Stop on the landing where both staircases meet.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn left onto the staircase.
Ascend the stairs.
Stop on the landing where the two staircases converge.

instruction: Go into the next room with the lit chandelier. Go to the top of the staircase in that room.
plan: Walk forward to the nearest door and open it.
Enter the room that contains the lit chandelier.
Locate the staircase and turn toward it.
Walk up the staircase to the top landing.

instruction: Go straight through the doorway, stop next to the chairs in the middle of the room.
plan: Walk forward toward the doorway.
Pass through the doorway into the next space.
Continue walking straight toward the center of the room.
Stop next to the chairs in the middle of the room.

instruction: Exit the room through the doorway to the left of the mirror on the wall. Continue straight into the next room and stop when you get to the empty table in the middle of the room.
plan: Locate the mirror on the wall and identify the doorway to its left.
Walk to and exit through that left doorway.
Continue walking straight ahead into the next room.
Move forward until the empty table in the center of the room is reached.
Stop at the table.

instruction: Walk through the door furthest away from you and take a left. Wait at the top of the white marble stairs.
plan: Walk straight to the door that is farthest away and go through it.
Turn left immediately after exiting the door.
Continue forward until you reach the top of the white marble stairs.
Stop and wait at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Turn left out of the doorway and follow the red carpet runner through the hallway. Enter the next room and walk until just past the stairs and stop.
plan: Turn left and exit the doorway.
Walk forward along the red carpet runner down the hallway.
Enter the room that appears next.
Continue walking straight past the stairs inside the room.
Stop just beyond the stairs.

instruction: Turn to your right. Go through the doorway on your left behind the rope. Go down the hallway and stop at the top of the staircase on the left.
plan: Turn to your right.
Walk to the doorway on your left behind the rope and go through it.
Continue walking straight down the hallway.
Stop at the top of the staircase on the left.

instruction: Go straight and pass the chairs and the large mirror on the right then turn right and head toward the stairs. Wait on the second step to the top.
plan: Walk straight ahead, passing the chairs and the large mirror on the right.
Turn right.
Continue forward toward the staircase.
Ascend the stairs to the second step.
Stop and wait on the second step.

instruction: Walk towards long red rug and turn left through doorway, Walk through doorway and turn right and proceed down that long red rug. Once you reach a red striped chair on your left, make your way to the white marble stairs. Go up them and take the red carpeted staircase on your right. Stop on the second step.
plan: Walk forward to the long red rug, turn left, and go through the doorway.
Turn right and continue along the long red rug until the red striped chair is on your left.
Move to the white marble stairs and ascend them.
Turn right onto the red‑carpeted staircase.
Stop on the second step of that staircase.

instruction: Walk out the door to your right. Once out turn right and go up the white stairs. Once at the top of the white stairs turn right and go up the red stairs. Stop at the top of the first set of red stairs.
plan: Walk straight out the door on your right.
Turn right and go up the white stairs.
At the top of the white stairs, turn right and go up the first set of red stairs.
Stop at the top of the red stairs.

instruction: Follow red carpet, turn right at chandileir, wait at top of stairs.
plan: Walk forward following the red carpet.
Continue until you reach the chandelier.
Turn right at the chandelier.
Proceed to the top of the stairs.
Stop and wait at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Exit the room into the room on the left, turn right and then left and go to the top of the stairs and stop.
plan: Exit the current room into the room on the left.
Turn right.
Turn left.
Walk to the top of the stairs.
Stop.

instruction: walk towards the red rope.
plan: Walk forward towards the red rope.
Stop when you reach the red rope.

instruction: Walk toward the roped off seating area. Walk to the door behind the chairs on the right hand side of the roped off seating area. Walk through the door and to fireplace with a mirror above it.
plan: Walk forward to the roped‑off seating area.
Move to the right side of the seating area and locate the door behind the chairs.
Walk to the door behind the chairs.
Pass through the door.
Walk to the fireplace with a mirror above it.

instruction: Go down the hallway on the right.  Turn right and stop in front of the marble and gold coffee table.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway on the right.
Turn right at the end of the hallway.
Stop directly in front of the marble and gold coffee table.

instruction: Follow the red carpet down the hall, past the fire extinguishers on the floor. Angle slightly left and walk through the double doors ahead and to the left. Follow the red carpet to the end of the ropes and turn right, waiting in the doorway.
plan: Walk forward along the red carpet down the hall, passing the fire extinguishers on the floor.
Angle slightly left and go through the double doors ahead and to the left.
Continue following the red carpet until you reach the end of the ropes.
Turn right into the doorway at the rope’s end.
Stop and wait in the doorway.

instruction: Walk down the stairs and stop on the landing at the bottom of the stairs.
plan: Face the staircase.
Walk down the stairs.
Reach the landing at the bottom.
Stop on the landing.

instruction: Head down the hallway and stop next to the table.
plan: Walk forward down the hallway.
Continue until you see the table.
Stop next to the table.

instruction: Walk over the red velvet rope and into the room with the large hanging chandelier. Walk over the next velvet rope, and wait beside the table in the center of the room.
plan: Walk forward to the red velvet rope.
Step over the red velvet rope and enter the room with the large hanging chandelier.
Proceed to the next velvet rope inside the room.
Step over the second velvet rope.
Stop and wait beside the table in the center of the room.

instruction: Move around the table and to the right. Then go over or under rope and move forward. Continue down the hall straight, then through the doors. Turn to your left and continue forward and up the stairs.
plan: Walk around the table to the right.
Cross the rope (over or under) and continue moving forward.
Continue straight down the hallway and pass through the doors.
Turn left and proceed forward.
Ascend the stairs.

instruction: Walk across room to opening on the left. Wait at 3 chairs.
plan: Walk straight forward across the room.
Turn left and proceed toward the opening.
Continue through the opening until you reach the area with three chairs.
Stop and wait beside the three chairs.

instruction: Walk and turn left at the first corner. Keep walking straight along until you see a white and red striped chair and a staircase. Turn left and walk up the first three white steps and stop there.
plan: Walk forward to the first corner and turn left.
Continue straight ahead until you see the white and red striped chair and the staircase.
Turn left toward the staircase.
Walk up the first three white steps.
Stop at the top of the third white step.

instruction: Walk straight across the room and into the next one. Wait near the wardrobe.
plan: Walk straight across the current room toward the doorway.
Continue through the doorway into the next room.
Stop and wait near the wardrobe.

instruction: Walk down the hall and to the left. Walk through the doors and down the hall. Stop in front of the double doors.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn left and proceed.
Walk through the doors.
Continue down the hallway.
Stop in front of the double doors.

instruction: Walk down the hallway to the right of the fireplace, then turn left and go up the white stairs.Then go up the right hand side of the red steps and wait at the top.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway that is to the right of the fireplace.
Turn left and ascend the white stairs.
Continue up the right‑hand side of the red steps.
Stop and wait at the top of the stairs.

instruction: turn around walk through the large doorway, stop near the fireplace.
plan: Turn around (rotate 180°).
Walk straight forward through the large doorway.
Stop near the fireplace.

instruction: Turn around and walk through the next room.  Then enter the doorway on your left. Stand next to the fireplace.
plan: Turn around (rotate 180°).
Walk forward through the next room.
Turn left and enter the doorway on your left.
Walk toward the fireplace inside the room.
Stop and stand next to the fireplace.

instruction: Turn and enter the doorway on your left. Go down the short hallway and enter the room with the large stairway in it. Across the room, there will be two doors. Go into the one on the right, closest to the window. Take one step into the room and wait.
plan: Turn left and enter the doorway on your left.
Walk down the short hallway and enter the room that contains the large stairway.
Cross the room to the door on the right side closest to the window and go through it.
Take one step into the next room and stop.

instruction: Turn right out the doors beside you. Once out, turn right and walk out the next set of doors and down the hallway until the room opens up. Once you reach the room, turn left and walk up the few steps in front of you and stop.
plan: Turn right and exit through the doors beside you.
After exiting, turn right and walk through the next set of doors.
Continue down the hallway until the room opens up ahead.
Turn left upon reaching the room entrance.
Walk up the few steps in front of you and stop.

instruction: Turn right and go through the hallway until you get to a room with pink couches. Wait near the fireplace.
plan: Turn right.
Walk forward down the hallway.
Enter the room when you see pink couches.
Move toward the fireplace inside the room.
Wait near the fireplace.

instruction: Go straight past the fireplace then turn right. Go straight through the hall. Wait near the chairs and table on the left.
plan: Walk straight ahead past the fireplace.
Turn right.
Continue walking straight through the hall.
Stop and wait near the chairs and table on the left.

instruction: walk down carpeted hallway to the left of fireplace, walk through double doors, turn left when you reach the top of the stairs, walk over rope and stop next to table.
plan: Walk forward down the carpeted hallway located to the left of the fireplace.
Walk through the double doors.
Turn left when you reach the top of the stairs.
Walk across the rope.
Stop next to the table.

instruction: Walk forward, past the sitting area and follow the red carpet into the next room. Following the red carpet, turn right and then left. Wait at the top of the stairs on the right.
plan: Walk forward past the sitting area.
Follow the red carpet into the next room.
Turn right while on the carpet.
Turn left.
Stop at the top of the stairs on the right.

instruction: Move forward past the table with the drawer open. Continue down the hallway.
plan: Walk forward until you have passed the table with the drawer open.
Continue walking straight down the hallway.

instruction: Exit the room using the door on the left. Turn right and wait near the table and chairs with the chandelier.
plan: Walk to the door on the left side of the room and exit.
Turn right immediately after exiting.
Proceed to the area with the table and chairs that feature the chandelier.
Stop and wait near that table and chairs.

instruction: Turn around and exit out the wood and green door to the right of the fire extinguisher. Walk forward until you reach the rope. Stop on the other side of the rope when you reach the next rug.
plan: Turn around.
Exit through the wood and green door located to the right of the fire extinguisher.
Walk forward until you reach the rope.
Continue past the rope to the other side.
Stop when you reach the rug on that side.

instruction: Exit the room through the doors to the left of the fireplace. Wait at the top of the stairs.
plan: Walk to the fireplace and locate the doors on its left side.
Open the left‑hand doors and exit the room.
Turn toward the staircase and walk up the stairs.
Continue to the top landing of the stairs.
Stop and wait at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Go on floor runner and turn left. Go through the entrance way and wait by the striped chair.
plan: Walk onto the floor runner.
Turn left while staying on the runner.
Proceed through the entrance way.
Stop and wait by the striped chair.

instruction: Walk through the door to the left of the fireplace. Take a slight right to walk up the stairs. Wait on the first landing of the red stairs.
plan: Walk forward through the door that is to the left of the fireplace.
Turn slightly right and proceed up the stairs.
Stop and wait on the first landing of the red stairs.

instruction: Walk through the entryway and left up the stairs that curve left. Stop at the top of the stairs.
plan: Walk straight forward through the entryway.
Turn left onto the staircase.
Ascend the stairs that curve left.
Continue to the top of the stairs.
Stop at the landing.

instruction: Turn around and walk through the small hallway. Once in the next room, walk to the other side and enter the door on the far left. Stop before you reach the double doors on your right.
plan: Turn around.
Walk forward through the small hallway into the next room.
Walk across the room to the opposite side.
Enter the door on the far left.
Stop before the double doors on your right.

instruction: Go straight into the door in the middle and wait by the fireplace.
plan: Walk straight toward the door in the middle.
Open the middle door and step inside.
Continue walking forward into the room.
Locate the fireplace.
Stop and wait next to the fireplace.

instruction: Go down the stairs to the first landing. Turn right and go down three more steps.
plan: Walk down the stairs until reaching the first landing.
Turn right at the landing.
Walk down three more steps.
Stop at the bottom of the third step.

instruction: Go left to go into the room with crowd control ropes. Walk to the top of the staircase.
plan: Turn left and enter the room marked by crowd control ropes.
Walk forward to locate the staircase inside the room.
Ascend the staircase and stop at the top landing.

instruction: Turn left and walk through the doorway to the left of the mirror. Wait in the doorway on the right.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward to the doorway that is left of the mirror.
Pass through the doorway.
Stop and wait in the doorway on the right side.

instruction: Make a left to exit room, proceed down hallway, and stop in fainting room.
plan: Turn left to exit the room.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Stop in the fainting room.

instruction: Exit the room through the door to the right of the fireplace. Walk through the hallway, then veer right and continue to the nearest end of the table to your right.
plan: Locate the door to the right of the fireplace and exit the room.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn/veer right within the hallway.
Continue forward until you reach the nearest end of the table on your right.
Stop at that table end.

instruction: Enter the room straight ahead and wait next to the table.
plan: Walk straight ahead into the room.
Approach the table inside the room.
Stop and wait next to the table.

instruction: Step down and go forward and then turn left. Proceed to the stairs and go down to the first landing. Turn to the right and go down two more steps. Wait there.
plan: Step down, walk forward, and turn left.
Approach the stairs and descend to the first landing.
Turn right.
Descend two additional steps.
Stop and wait at the final position.

instruction: Walk through the door between the two fireplaces. Veer right and step onto the rug. Stop on the rug in front of the armoire.
plan: Walk to the door located between the two fireplaces and go through it.
Veer right immediately after entering the doorway.
Step onto the rug.
Stop on the rug positioned in front of the armoire.

instruction: Exit the room through the door near the fireplace, then wait in the dining room near the table.
plan: Walk to the door located near the fireplace.
Open the door and exit the room.
Proceed straight into the dining room.
Locate the dining table.
Stop and wait near the table.

instruction: Walk forward towards the staircases and go up the staircase on the left. Once you have finished climbing up the first set of stairs there will be a short landing area. Wait there do not continue upstairs or go back downstairs on the set of stairs in front of you.
plan: Walk straight ahead toward the staircase area.
Turn left and step onto the left-hand staircase.
Ascend the first flight of stairs to the landing.
Stop and wait on the landing; do not continue up or go back down.

instruction: Walk down the stairs to the first land and wait there, near the baluster.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Continue until you reach the first landing.
Position yourself near the baluster on the landing.
Stop and wait there.

instruction: Walk down one flight of stairs and stop on the landing.
plan: Walk forward to the staircase entrance.
Descend the stairs, completing one flight.
Arrive at the bottom landing.
Stop on the landing.

instruction: Walk down the first flight of stairs and turn right. Go down 2 steps and stop.
plan: Walk down the first flight of stairs.
Turn right.
Walk down two steps.
Stop.

instruction: Walk through the open door and turn right. Walk up the stairs. Walk up more stairs to the right. Wait at the first landing.
plan: Walk forward through the open door.
Turn right.
Walk up the stairs.
Continue walking up the stairs to the right.
Stop at the first landing.

instruction: Go straight and into the room on the right. Stop next to the light on the left.
plan: Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn right and enter the room on the right.
Walk forward toward the left side of the room.
Stop next to the light on the left.

instruction: walk forward then turn right at the stairs then go down the stairs.
plan: Walk forward until you reach the stairs.
Turn right at the stairs.
Descend the stairs.

instruction: Walk through the doorway between the two fireplaces. Wait at the gilded armoire.
plan: Approach the doorway positioned between the two fireplaces.
Walk straight through the doorway.
Continue to the gilded armoire.
Stop and wait at the gilded armoire.

instruction: Turn around and exit the door to the right of the fire extinguisher. Walk forward and enter the next room. Walk over to the small table and stop behind the first stool you reach.
plan: Turn around.
Exit through the door located to the right of the fire extinguisher.
Walk forward and enter the next room.
Walk over to the small table.
Stop behind the first stool you reach.

instruction: Walk down the red carpet that passes the mirror on the right. Take a left when you pass through the doorway, and continue to walk on the carpet and stop in front of the pillar.
plan: Walk forward on the red carpet, keeping the mirror on your right side.
Continue straight until you reach the doorway and walk through it.
Immediately after the doorway, turn left while staying on the carpet.
Walk forward on the carpet toward the pillar.
Stop directly in front of the pillar.

instruction: Turn 180 degrees to face the room with the fireplace. Walk forward past the fireplace. Continue down the red carpet past the stanchions. Stop in front of the double doors.
plan: Turn 180 degrees to face the room with the fireplace.
Walk forward past the fireplace.
Continue forward on the red carpet, passing the stanchions.
Stop in front of the double doors.

instruction: Turn right at ropes and walk straight down hall to steps on left. Walk up steps and stop at the top of them.
plan: Turn right when you reach the ropes.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn left onto the steps that are on your left.
Walk up the steps.
Stop at the top of the steps.

instruction: Walk straight, take a sharp right turn and continue down the corridor before making a slight right turn to the top of the steps.
plan: Walk straight ahead.
Make a sharp right turn.
Continue walking down the corridor.
Take a slight right turn toward the stairs.
Stop at the top of the steps.

instruction: Head downstairs and wait where the stair splits two ways.
plan: Walk to the staircase and begin descending.
Continue down the stairs until you reach the point where the stairs split into two ways.
Stop at the split.

instruction: Turn right and down the hallway. Turn left and wait near the round table .
plan: Turn right.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn left.
Stop and wait near the round table.

instruction: Walk across sitting room taking exit on the right. Walk to large room with table in the middle. Stop next to the table.
plan: Walk straight across the sitting room toward the right‑hand exit.
Turn right and enter the large room.
Walk toward the center of the room where the table is located.
Stop next to the table.

instruction: Exit the room and walk down the hall. Wait by the table.
plan: Walk to the doorway and exit the room.
Continue walking straight down the hall.
Stop and wait by the table.

instruction: Exit the room by walking down the stairs, then wait on the first landing by the banister.
plan: Walk to the staircase inside the room.
Descend the stairs to exit the room.
Stop on the first landing and wait beside the banister.

instruction: Go through the hallway to the left, and walk to the left corner of the rope and stop.
plan: Turn left and enter the hallway.
Walk forward through the hallway.
Turn left toward the rope and approach its left side.
Walk to the left corner of the rope.
Stop at the corner.

instruction: Turn left into the hallway. Go straight until you get to the oval table.Wait there.
plan: Turn left and enter the hallway.
Walk straight ahead until you see the oval table.
Stop at the oval table and wait.

instruction: Make a hard right. Make a hard right. Walk past the fireplace on the left. Walk past the round table on the right. Walk past the fireplace on the left. Wait at the wall mirror to the right of the french doors with green glass.
plan: Make a hard right turn.
Make another hard right turn.
Walk forward past the fireplace on the left.
Continue walking forward past the round table on the right and the next fireplace on the left.
Stop at the wall mirror to the right of the French doors with green glass.

instruction: Walk past the rope line and exit the room through the door on your right.  Turn left and walk down the hall.  Turn right and walk up marble steps.  Wait on the landing.
plan: Walk past the rope line and exit the room through the door on the right.
Turn left and walk down the hall.
Turn right and walk up the marble steps.
Stop and wait on the landing.

instruction: Go straight until you get to the table and chairs then turn left and go down the stairs. Turn right and go down three steps then stop.
plan: Walk straight until you reach the table and chairs.
Turn left.
Walk down the stairs.
Turn right.
Walk down three steps and stop.

instruction: Walk past the fireplace and exit the room through the doorway on the right. Immediately turn left, walk through the hallway, turn right and wait on the stairway landing.
plan: Walk straight past the fireplace and exit the room through the doorway on the right.
Turn left.
Walk forward through the hallway.
Turn right onto the stairway landing.
Stop and wait on the landing.

instruction: Pass the fireplace on your right. Take a right. Go down the hall. Cross the room and go to the top of the stairs.
plan: Walk forward, keeping the fireplace on your right.
Turn right.
Walk down the hall.
Cross the room.
Continue to the top of the stairs.

instruction: Head towards the door with the fire extinguisher beside it.  Pass through the seating area and go through the double doors on your left. Stop in front of the fireplace and wait there.
plan: Walk straight toward the door that has a fire extinguisher beside it.
Pass through the seating area on the way.
Turn left and go through the double doors.
Proceed to the fireplace and stand in front of it.
Stop and wait there.

instruction: Go down the stairs, at the first landing go to the right and stop.
plan: Walk down the stairs.
Upon reaching the first landing, turn right.
Stop at the right side of the landing.

instruction: Go forward to edge of bed. Stop at door exit.
plan: Walk straight forward until you reach the edge of the bed.
Continue walking forward toward the door.
Stop at the door exit.

instruction: Walk across the living room, past the fireplace and exit through the doorway on your right.  Walk down the red carpet into the next room and stand next to the dining room table.
plan: Walk forward across the living room, passing the fireplace.
Exit through the doorway on your right.
Walk down the red carpet into the next room.
Stop and stand next to the dining room table.

instruction: Head inside the building, turn left once inside, go to the opening on the left, go through the opening, stop once outside.
plan: Walk straight forward to enter the building.
Turn left inside the building.
Walk straight to the opening on the left side.
Pass through the opening to exit the building.
Stop immediately after emerging outside.

instruction: Walk forward and make a left into the first hallway. Continue down that hallway and climb over the ropes in front of you, if they are there. Wait on the oriental rug on the floor in the sitting area.
plan: Walk forward.
Turn left into the first hallway.
Continue walking down the hallway.
Climb over the ropes in front of you, if they are present.
Stop on the oriental rug in the sitting area.

instruction: With the fireplace on your right, walk down the red carpet toward the two oval backed chairs.  When you get to the corner turn right and walk to the area where another red carpet intersects.  Stop in the middle of that red carpet.  There is a small square red carpet next to you there.
plan: Walk straight forward on the red carpet, keeping the fireplace on your right, toward the two oval‑backed chairs.
When you reach the corner, turn right.
Continue walking straight until you reach the point where another red carpet intersects the one you’re on.
Stop in the middle of the intersecting red carpet.

instruction: Go to the left and through the doorway.  Then go into the bedroom, and past the bed.  Then turn left You'll see a pool outside.  Just wait right at the doorway.
plan: Turn left and walk through the doorway.
Enter the bedroom and walk past the bed.
Turn left toward the pool outside.
Stop and wait at the doorway.

instruction: Walk straight to the staircase and wait at the top of the stairs.
plan: Walk straight ahead until you reach the staircase.
Turn onto the staircase and ascend to the top.
Stop and wait at the top of the stairs.

instruction: Turn left and walk on the path towards the pillars. Wait by the glass door entrance to the right.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward along the path toward the pillars.
Continue until you see the glass‑door entrance on your right.
Stop and wait by the glass‑door entrance.

instruction: Stand with the door behind you and go up the staircase on your left.  Stop where the other staircase meets up, just before the single staircase going up.
plan: Turn around so the door is directly behind you.
Locate the staircase on your left and position yourself at its base.
Walk up the left staircase.
Stop at the landing where the second staircase meets, stopping just before the single staircase continues upward.

instruction: Go straight until you pass the chairs on the right. Turn right and then turn left. Wait near the chandelier.
plan: Walk straight ahead until the chairs on your right have been passed.
Turn right.
Turn left.
Stop and wait near the chandelier.

instruction: Walk from the small pool and make a left so you are in front of the pool then make another left so you are in front of the big pool. Walk straight to the black door and wait inside the door.
plan: Turn left from the small pool and move until you are directly in front of the pool.
Turn left again and walk to a position directly in front of the big pool.
Walk straight ahead toward the black door.
Enter the black door and wait inside.

instruction: Go straight past the two fireplaces on the left. Wait near the three chairs on the left.
plan: Walk straight forward, passing the two fireplaces that are on your left.
Continue walking until you reach the area where three chairs are positioned on your left.
Stop and wait near the three chairs.

instruction: turn slight left and follow path along bushes, turn slight left and walk along concrete walk to open door, stand in doorway facing picture.
plan: Turn slight left and follow the path along the bushes.

Move forward past the white couch and the black table.
Continue to the base of the white stairs.
Ascend the white stairs.
Stop at the top of the stairs.

Walk forward to enter the bedroom.
Turn left inside the bedroom.
Walk forward and exit onto the patio.

plan: Turn around until you are facing the other house.
Walk straight across the deck.
Go through the open door.
Take a few steps forward inside.
Stop on the rug.

plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk forward through the kitchen.
Turn right.
Walk forward into the dining room.

plan: Walk through the entrance into the building.
Continue straight, passing the dining‑room table and chairs.
Enter the room directly beyond the dining area.
Move toward the glass windows inside that room.
Stop in front of the glass windows.

plan: Walk out of the laundry room.
Turn left and proceed down the hallway.
Continue until you reach the counter, then turn right.
Walk toward the dining room entryway.
Stop and wait in the entryway of the dining room.

plan: Walk outside to the sitting area.
Re‑enter the building and go to the bedroom.
Walk past the couch.
Continue to the outdoor bathroom.
Stop at the outdoor bathroom.

instruction: Walk towards the kitchen.  Turn right and walk down hallway.  Stop when you reach the dinner table.  Wait here.
plan: Walk straight toward the kitchen.
Turn right and continue down the hallway.
Stop when you reach the dinner table.
Wait at the dinner table.

plan: Walk straight to the open door while staying on the same level (avoid any steps).
Enter the space through the open door.
Go through the interior door that leads to the kitchen.
Walk across the kitchen toward the washer and dryer.
Stop in the doorway that opens to the bathroom.

instruction: Walk up the stairs ahead. Wait next to the entrance of the house.
plan: Walk forward to the stairs ahead.
Ascend the stairs to the upper level.
Move toward the entrance of the house.
Stop and wait next to the entrance.

instruction: Turn left and go past the bed. Go straight and exit the glass door on the left. Wait at the balcony.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward past the bed.
Continue straight to the glass door on the left and exit.
Move onto the balcony.
Wait on the balcony.

plan: Walk forward toward the pool.
Circle the pool by turning and walking around it.
Stop at the point where the circle is completed.

instruction: Walk towards staircase. Walk up stairs.  Wait near top.
plan: Walk straight towards the staircase.
Ascend the stairs to the upper level.
Stop and wait near the top of the stairs.

plan: Enter the building through the main entrance.
Walk straight past the kitchen sink.
Locate the bathroom doorway that is directly across from the washer and dryer.
Stop in the bathroom doorway.
Wait in place.

plan: Face the pool and locate the path that leads away from it.
Walk straight forward along that path, keeping the pool behind you.
Continue until you see an open door on your left side.
Identify the last open door on the left (the furthest one along the path).
Stop directly in front of that door.

plan: Exit the room.
Walk straight ahead.
When you reach the kitchen, turn right.
Continue walking past the ovens on the right side.
Stop at the large black glass table with chairs.

Walk straight forward, keeping the stove on your left, then pass the sink, refrigerator, and the washing machine and dryer.
Continue straight to the doorway of the bedroom directly ahead.
Stop in the bedroom doorway.

plan: Turn left.
Walk around the bed and turn left.
Exit the room.
Turn right.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Take a hard left turn and walk down the corridor, stopping near the window.
plan: Turn hard left.
Walk forward down the corridor.
Continue until the window is in view.
Stop near the window.

plan: Turn left and walk straight into the room.
Walk toward the left side of the room.
Locate the door on your right and walk through it.
Stop once you are outside the door.

Turn right.
Continue walking straight toward the staircase that leads downstairs.
Stop and wait at the top of that staircase.

Turn left.
Walk forward past the purple flowers.
Stop in the doorway that is to the right of the towels.

Turn left before reaching the sink.
Continue walking toward the window area.
Stop a short distance before the bar.

Turn onto the staircase and begin descending.
Continue down the stairs until you are at the middle of the staircase, then stop.

Continue straight until you reach the house entrance.
Enter the house through the doorway.
Walk to the dining area and approach the dining table.
Stop and wait at the dining table.

Walk toward the bed, pass it, and turn left toward the corner.
Enter the corner area and turn right toward the bathroom.
Stop at the bathroom entrance.

instruction: Head outside. Go past the pool. Stop bu the table and chairs.
plan: Walk straight toward the outdoor exit.
Continue walking past the pool.
Stop by the table and chairs.

Turn left when you reach the corner.
Continue walking forward and stop inside the door.

Turn right.
Enter the large bedroom suite.
Stop near the bathroom.

Turn right.
Walk forward to the couch.
Turn left.
Go out the door onto the patio.

Walk forward down the hallway.

Turn left.
Stop and wait in the hallway.

Stop when you reach the patio beside the pool.

Turn right after passing the wood wall.
Continue straight ahead.
Turn left.
Stop at the top of the staircase.

Walk forward toward the potted plant.

Continue straight ahead and enter the next doorway leading to the bathroom.

When you arrive next to the pool, turn left.
Continue left until you reach the steps that lead into the pool.
Stop in front of the pool steps.

Turn left.
Walk up the short stairs.
Enter the leftmost room.

plan: Walk to the right, circling around the glass panels.
Continue straight down the stairs.
At the bottom of the stairs, turn left.
Stop and wait in front of the glass table.

Exit the room through the doorway you reach.
Continue walking straight down the hallway.
Enter the second door on the left.
Stop and wait inside the entered room.

Stop and wait near the ottoman.

Continue straight until you reach the large open doorway.

Continue up the staircase to the next level.
After reaching the landing, keep moving past the stairs that are on your right side.

Continue straight, passing the sink on your left/right.
Proceed to the doorway of the walk‑in closet.
Stop and wait at the doorway.

Turn left at the doorway of that room.
Step forward into the hallway.

Turn right.
Walk forward into the dining room.

Wait in the bathroom.

Walk straight down the hallway.
Stop at the stairs.

Upon reaching the sink counter, turn and continue past the ovens.
Proceed until you arrive at the entrance of the great room.

Walk forward to the couch.
Turn left.
Walk forward to the balcony.
Stop at the balcony.

Continue past the stairs on the left side.
Proceed down the hallway.
Enter the first doorway you encounter.
Stop inside the doorway.

Turn left.
Walk toward the table and chairs.
Continue to the area with the couches.
Stop and wait near the couches.

Walk straight down the hallway.
At the fork, turn right.
Continue forward until you pass the oven.
Stop shortly after the oven.

Turn left at the pillar.
Enter the hallway ahead.
Continue forward until you are just before the bathroom entrance.
Stop at that point.

plan: Walk straight ahead toward the staircase.
Keep the staircase on your right and continue forward.
Turn right into the doorway on the right.
Stop inside the doorway.

Turn left inside the bathroom.
Walk forward to enter the closet.
Continue forward and stop once you have passed the closet doorway.

Turn right at the staircase.

Walk straight ahead.
Exit through the wooden glass door.

instruction: Turn left and exit the bathroom. Turn right and walk forward to the open door way on your left. Walk through the doorway and then turn left. Walk past the long white table on your left. When you reach the long white table on your right, turn left and enter the dining room and stop.
plan: Turn left and exit the bathroom.
Turn right, walk forward to the open doorway on your left, and go through it.
Turn left after entering the new area.
Walk past the long white table on your left.
When you reach the long white table on your right, turn left, enter the dining room, and stop.

instruction: From the front door you need to walk straight back until you get to the table with the white table cloth. When you walk to the end of the table make a left and stand in the doorway. Make a right when you are in the doorway and go to the bathroom doorway. You have to wait in the doorway.
plan: Walk straight from the front door until you reach the table with the white table cloth.
Continue to the end of the table, turn left, and stop in the doorway.
Turn right in that doorway and walk to the bathroom doorway.
Stop and wait in the bathroom doorway.

instruction: Go straight toward the fireplace then turn left and pass the stairs on your left then stop.
plan: Walk straight toward the fireplace.
Turn left.
Continue walking past the stairs on your left.
Stop at the endpoint.

instruction: Walk into the room, and go straight. Walk pass the white table, and stairs. Stop once you step onto the tile from the wood floor.
plan: Walk into the room.
Continue straight ahead.
Pass the white table.
Pass the stairs.
Stop as soon as you step onto the tile floor.

instruction: Move past the table and enter the door with a garbage bin next to it. Stand near the entrance.
plan: Walk straight ahead past the table.
Turn toward the door with the garbage bin beside it.
Open the door and step inside.
Move a short distance forward to stand near the entrance.

instruction: Turn around and pass the basin. Enter the double doors and turn left. Then take your next right and stop.
plan: Turn around and walk forward past the basin.
Enter the double doors and turn left.
Take the next right turn.
Stop at that location.

instruction: Exit the bathroom and turn right. Then take the next left and the next left. Follow the hall and stop before the fireplace.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn right.
Take the next left turn.
Take the following left turn.
Walk forward down the hallway and stop just before the fireplace.

plan: Walk straight down the corridor.
Continue past the stairs.
Turn right and go through the doorway.
Enter the men's bathroom.
Stop and wait inside.

plan: Exit the room.
Turn right and walk straight until you reach the round table.
Turn right and enter the hallway.
Turn right and go into the room on the left.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Walk past the cloth table and toward the entryway to the outside. Stop in the entryway.
plan: Walk forward until you pass the cloth table.
Continue straight toward the entryway leading outside.
Stop in the entryway.

instruction: Turn to your right and walk towards the door going outside. Once you are in front of the door leading to outside, turn right and go into the room. Stop right inside the door beside the chair.
plan: Turn right.
Walk forward until you reach the exterior door.
Turn right at the exterior door entrance.
Enter the room through the door.
Stop right inside the doorway beside the chair.

instruction: Walk through the two benches and head outside. Stop once you are outside, before you reach the pillars.
plan: Walk forward until you reach the first bench.
Continue forward, passing between the two benches.
Proceed straight to the doorway leading outside.
Exit through the doorway into the outdoor area.
Stop immediately before the first set of pillars.

instruction: Walk to the foot of the bed and turn right towards the fireplace.  Stand in the corner behind the chair and the fireplace.
plan: Walk forward until you reach the foot of the bed.
Turn right to face the fireplace.
Continue walking toward the fireplace until you reach the corner behind the chair.
Stop and stand in that corner.
