plan: Walk to the opening on the right side of the fireplace and exit the room.
Turn left and move forward toward the opposite corner of the space.
Pass through the pocket‑door opening located in that corner.
Continue forward until you reach the dining table with twelve chairs.
Stop next to the dining table.

instruction: Exit the room to the left. Continue to turn left and walk past the office on your right. When you see the underside of a staircase, look left for an entryway marked "Restroom" and head towards it. Stop in front of the water fountain.
plan: Turn left and exit the current room.
Continue turning left, walking past the office that is on your right.
When you see the underside of a staircase, look left, locate the entryway marked “Restroom,” and move toward it.
Enter the restroom area and proceed to the water fountain.
Stop in front of the water fountain.

instruction: Walk past all the round tables and stop to the left of the last one.
plan: Walk forward, passing each round table in sequence.
Recognize when you reach the final round table.
Move to the left side of that last round table.
Stop at that position.

instruction: Go indoors. Walk straight until you almost past the stairs on the left and turn right into the room. Wait at the entrance.
plan: Walk forward to enter the indoor space.
Continue straight until you are just beyond the stairs on the left.
Turn right and proceed into the adjacent room.
Stop at the entrance of the room and wait.

instruction: Go indoors and head straight then after you pass the bar turn left and wait by the black bench on our right.
plan: Walk through the entrance to go indoors.
Continue walking straight down the hallway.
After passing the bar, turn left.
Stop and wait by the black bench on the right side.

instruction: walk away from door to outside, straight down hallway, turn left at fireplace, turn right and walk through double doors and stop.
plan: Walk out the door to the outside.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Turn left when you reach the fireplace.
Turn right and walk through the double doors.
Stop at the doorway.

instruction: Exit the room. Turn left and walk toward the fireplace. Turn left and then turn right into the room by the fireplace. Wait near the large double doors.
plan: Exit the room.
Turn left and walk toward the fireplace.
Turn left.
Turn right into the room by the fireplace.
Stop and wait near the large double doors.

plan: Turn around (rotate 180 degrees).
Walk to the right side of the table.
Proceed to the right doorway next to the tea cart and go through it.
Move toward the Christmas tree area.
Stop next to the first chair by the Christmas tree.

plan: Walk forward toward the exit door of the dining room.
Pass through the doorway to leave the dining room.
Stop and wait at the exit door.

plan: Walk straight toward the fireplace and turn left.
Continue past the table in the center of the room and move through the entryway.
Turn right.
Stop just inside the bathroom.

plan: Walk straight ahead to the small white table positioned in the middle of the room.
Stop at the table and orient yourself toward the opposite side of the room.
Turn around (or turn 180 degrees) to face the doorway leading to the room across.
Walk through the doorway and enter the room with the drinking fountain.
Stop near the drinking fountain.

plan: Exit the room.
Turn left and pass the black bench on the left.
Turn left again.
Walk past the stairs on the left.
Stop and wait at that location.

plan: Walk to the right side of the table heading toward the Christmas tree.
Turn left and proceed straight ahead.
Turn left again, moving around the table.
Stop near the painting.

plan: Walk straight forward after entering the room.
When you reach the circular marble table in the middle, turn left.
Continue walking left until you arrive at the drinking fountain.
Stop directly in front of the drinking fountain.

instruction: Exit the room. Turn right then turn left. Walk straight past the stairs on the right then turn right. Wait near the black bench on the right.
plan: Exit the room.
Turn right, then immediately turn left.
Walk straight past the stairs on the right.
Turn right.
Wait near the black bench on the right.

instruction: Leave dining room to main lobby, walk towards main entry. Stop at entry doors.
plan: Walk out of the dining room into the main lobby.
Proceed straight towards the main entry doors.
Stop at the entry doors.

plan: Turn or adjust your heading until the fireplace is on your right side and the staircase is on your left side.
Walk straight ahead, keeping the double doors on your right, and pass them.
Continue to the far end of the room and step through the archway on your right.

instruction: Walk forward into the hallway. Take a left at the double pine doors. Enter the dining room and Stop.
plan: Walk forward into the hallway.
Turn left at the double pine doors.
Enter the dining room.
Stop.

instruction: Walk straight past the fireplace and past the long white table on the left.  Keep walking straight down the middle of this long room and stop after stepping off the wooden floor and onto the tile, almost under the last chandelier.
plan: Walk forward past the fireplace.
Continue straight, passing the long white table on the left.
Keep walking straight down the middle of the room.
Step onto the tile floor as the wooden floor ends.
Stop just under the last chandelier.

plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk forward, weaving through the tables and chairs toward the center of the room.
Arrive at the wide open space at the center and come to a stop.
Orient yourself to face the long table with the white tablecloth and the other tables and chairs on the opposite side of the room.

instruction: With the water fountain directly behind you, enter the room ahead and turn ninety degrees to the left and walk past the wooden staircase on your right. Turn right underneath the staircase and walk down the hallway leading to the exit. Just before reaching the exit, turn right into the room with the sign "Bridal Room" next to the entrance. Go to the right after you enter the room and wait in front to the two chairs that will be on your right.
plan: Walk forward and enter the room ahead.
Turn left 90°, walk past the wooden staircase on your right.
Turn right under the staircase and walk down the hallway toward the exit.
Just before the exit, turn right into the room with the "Bridal Room" sign.
After entering, go right and wait in front of the two chairs on your right.

instruction: Walk towards the water fountain and then pass through the opening to your right. Turn left and continue to the base of the stairs leading upwards that's ahead of you and to your right.
plan: Walk forward toward the water fountain.
Pass through the opening on your right.
Turn left.
Continue forward to the base of the stairs that lead upwards, located ahead and to your right.

instruction: Walk past the table and between the cloth covered tables. Walk through the entryway and to the left. Walk into the bathroom and to the right. Stop in front of the urinal.
plan: Walk forward past the table and between the cloth‑covered tables.
Continue through the entryway and turn left.
Enter the bathroom and turn right.
Walk forward toward the urinal.
Stop in front of the urinal.

instruction: Walk straight ahead across the room past the fireplace. Once you pass the fireplace, Turn right and stop in the doorway of the double wood doors.
plan: Walk straight ahead across the room toward the fireplace.
Continue past the fireplace.
Turn right.
Stop in the doorway of the double wood doors.

plan: Walk through the entrance and enter the building.
Continue straight through the main room until you reach the hallway on the left.
Turn right onto the hallway.
Enter the bathroom located on the left side of that hallway.
Stop and wait inside the bathroom.

instruction: Leave bathroom. turn slight right, head towards main room and stop there.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn slightly to the right.
Move forward toward the main room.
Stop upon reaching the main room.

instruction: Leave the restroom and walk out of the door. Make a left and walk right in front of the fireplace.
plan: Walk out of the restroom through the door.
Turn left.
Walk forward until you are directly in front of the fireplace and stop.

instruction: Walk out of the bathroom and turn right. Turn left and walk into the main room. Walk across the room and and to the left. Stop at the bottom of the stairs.
plan: Walk out of the bathroom and turn right.
Turn left and enter the main room.
Walk across the room toward the left side.
Stop at the bottom of the stairs.

plan: Walk forward through the tiled room, passing the padded benches on your side.
Continue straight, passing the bathroom and the table while staying close to the wall that has the white tablecloth.
Proceed forward to the open entryway ahead and walk through it, following the floor rug.

instruction: Walk to the opposite side of the dining area and wait there.
plan: Identify the dining area and face its center.
Walk straight across the dining area to the opposite side.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Go straight until you go out two double doors that lead to outside. Wait there.

Continue until you arrive at the two double doors leading outside.
Open and walk through the double doors to exit.
Stop and wait at the outside area.

Enter the large room that contains the stairs.
Walk forward until you see the doorway to the room with many round tables, chairs, and two large wooden doors.
Stop at that doorway and wait.

instruction: Continue alongside the glass on the left. Stop at the double wooden doors.
plan: Walk straight ahead, keeping the glass on your left.
Continue along the glass until the double wooden doors appear.
Stop at the double wooden doors.

plan: Turn right and go inside.
Walk straight, passing the black bench on each side.
Turn right.
Walk toward the stairs on the right.
Stop and wait at the stairs.

Turn right at the location opposite the fireplace.
Continue straight to the bench.
Stop and wait at the bench.

Walk forward past the black bench on the left.
Turn right and walk past the bar on the right.
Go out through the double glass doors.
Stop and wait at the doorway.

instruction: Exit the men's bathroom. Enter the ladies bathroom and wait there.
plan: Walk out of the men's bathroom.
Locate the entrance to the ladies bathroom.
Enter the ladies bathroom.
Stop and wait inside the ladies bathroom.

instruction: Walk past the bridal room and office toward the stone fireplace, and turn toward the exit and the stairs, and wait.

Continue past the office toward the stone fireplace.
Arrive at the stone fireplace.
Turn toward the exit and the stairs.
Stop and wait.

instruction: Walk into the building and past the fireplace. Walk through the door on the right and stop in the doorway.
plan: Walk straight into the building.
Continue forward past the fireplace.
Turn right and walk through the door on the right.
Stop in the doorway.

Find the houseplant and go to the door immediately to its right; go through that door.
After exiting, turn right.
Continue forward until you arrive at the area that contains a water fountain and three paintings.
Stop and wait in that area.

plan: Walk straight to the water dispenser.
Exit through the doorway on the left side.
Walk left of the white circular table, continuing toward the wooden staircase.

Walk straight, passing the marble table in the center and between the parallel leather benches.
Locate the door marked with the "exit" sign and walk through it.
Continue moving forward until you are outside.

instruction: Enter the house and turn left. Turn right and wait by the white chair.
plan: Walk forward to enter the house.
Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop and wait next to the white chair.

plan: Walk straight ahead toward the fireplace.
Turn right when you reach the fireplace.
Continue walking forward to the double doors.
Walk through the double doors.
Stop after entering the doorway.

Stop in front of the first urinal.

Continue forward on the tile floor until you reach the right‑hand opening marked “Restroom.”
Turn left and enter the men’s room through the opening.
Stop in front of the first urinal.

plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn left and move down the hallway.
Continue until you reach the fireplace, then turn left.
Proceed toward the stairs and coat room.
Stop and wait next to the stairs and coat room.

plan: Walk straight forward toward the fireplace.
Align with the door located to the left of the fireplace.
Turn left and approach the door.
Pass through the doorway.
Stop inside the room beyond the door.

plan: Walk forward into the dining room.
Turn toward the fireplace.
Walk to the double‑arched doors and turn left.
In the hall, step onto the brick on the right.
Stop.

plan: Walk toward and align with the left side of the cloth‑covered table.
Continue straight down the hall under the stairs.
Turn right.
Stop just inside the bridal room.

plan: Walk out of the bathroom.
Turn right.
Turn left and enter the main room.
Walk straight to the main door.
Open the door, step outside, and stop next to the door.

instruction: Exit the dining area. Walk to the left of the table with the white tablecloth. Wait next to the leather bench.
plan: Walk out of the dining area through the exit doorway.
Turn left and head toward the table with the white tablecloth.
Position yourself to the left side of that table.
Move to the leather bench located next to the table.
Stop and wait next to the bench.

instruction: Turn right and walk through the living area past the table covered in a white cloth.  Walk towards the long black bench.. Turn right and stand in front of the brown rug.
plan: Turn right.
Walk forward through the living area, passing the table covered with a white cloth.
Continue walking toward the long black bench.
Turn right.
Stop and stand in front of the brown rug.

plan: Walk to the double doors located just to the right of the fireplace and go through them.
Continue straight across the corridor.
Stop in the doorway leading to the bridal room and wait.

plan: Walk forward down the hallway.
Turn left.
Continue to the round table and turn right.
Walk to the doorway of the restrooms.
Stop in the restroom doorway.

plan: Walk straight through the entryway and cross the open door into the home.
Continue forward, passing the cushioned benches.
Turn and walk past the tiled room, moving beyond the closed door with a plaque above its entry.
Stop near the stairwell positioned on the same wall.

instruction: Walk towards the room with the fireplace. Make a left and walk towards the first set of hanging lights. Make a right and walk into the doorway of the double doors.
plan: Walk straight ahead until you reach the room with the fireplace.
Turn left and continue walking toward the first set of hanging lights.
Turn right and proceed into the doorway of the double doors.
Stop at the entrance of the double doors.

instruction: After you go inside the build walk straight back to the table by the staircase and wait.
plan: Enter the building.
Walk straight forward toward the staircase.
Continue until you reach the table beside the staircase.
Stop at the table and wait.

instruction: Turn right and walk across the hall towards the benches. Wait in between the benches by the entrance going outside.
plan: Turn right.
Walk straight across the hall toward the benches.
Stop between the benches by the entrance that leads outside.
Wait in that position.

plan: Walk straight forward into the reception area.
Continue past the first white table that is on your left.
Stop directly in front of the restroom doorway on the left.

instruction: Turn around and move down the hall past the tables. Turn right and wait in front of the water fountain.
plan: Turn around to face the opposite direction.
Walk forward down the hallway, passing the tables.
Turn right.
Continue walking until you reach the water fountain.
Stop and wait in front of the water fountain.

plan: Exit the bathroom and turn right to enter the main room.
Walk forward past the service buffet table.
Continue walking past the stairs.
Take the first right turn.
Stop in front of the bench below the bridal room sign.

plan: Turn 90 degrees.
Walk out through the bathroom doorway.
Turn right at the water fountain in the first right‑hand entryway.
Pass to the left of the marble table and move toward the base of the staircase.
Stop just before reaching the bottom of the staircase.

instruction: Walk into the hallway and past the bench. Turn left and walk past the fireplace. Walk onto the stone tile floor and stop.
plan: Walk straight into the hallway, passing the bench.
Turn left.
Walk forward past the fireplace.
Step onto the stone tile floor.
Stop.

instruction: Exit the room and turn left in the main corridor, pass the fireplace, then wait near the coat room.
plan: Walk straight to the doorway and exit the room.
Turn left onto the main corridor.
Continue forward, passing the fireplace on your side.
Stop and wait near the coat room.

instruction: Walk inside through both doorways, pass the table with the white tablecloth and make a left through the immediate doorway, then stop in front of the drinking fountain.
plan: Walk forward through the first doorway.
Continue forward through the second doorway.
Walk past the table covered with a white tablecloth.
Turn left and go through the immediate doorway on the left.
Stop directly in front of the drinking fountain.

instruction: Turn left and go through the door passed the sinks. Turn right and go through the leftmost entryway, then turn right and go into the hall and turn right. Stop in the bathroom.
plan: Turn left and go through the door past the sinks.
Turn right and go through the leftmost entryway.
Turn right into the hall.
Turn right and stop in the bathroom.

instruction: Exit the room. Turn left and walk toward the double doors. Go outside then wait.
plan: Exit the room.
Turn left.
Walk toward the double doors.
Go outside through the doors.
Wait.

instruction: Turn left and walk past the bar. Walk outside and stop just outside the doorway.
plan: Turn left.
Walk forward past the bar.
Continue walking toward the exit.
Stop just outside the doorway.

instruction: Walk straight across the room past the fire place and enter the doors to the right and stop.
plan: Walk straight forward across the room, passing the fireplace.
Turn right and walk through the doors.
Stop inside the doorway.

instruction: Walk past barber's chair. Walk into open door on left. Wait at end of half wall.
plan: Walk forward past the barber's chair.
Turn left and walk through the open door.
Continue to the end of the half wall.
Stop and wait there.

instruction: Go through the door between the tables with the white cloths on them. Go into the bathroom on the left. Stop in front of the garbage bin on the wall.
plan: Walk to the door positioned between the tables with white cloths.
Pass through that door.
Turn left to enter the bathroom.
Walk toward the garbage bin on the wall.
Stop directly in front of the garbage bin.

instruction: walk past the fireplace to your left and enter the next room through the open door. Walk past the long white table on your right and stand in hallway on the next room. Stand next to the water fountain.
plan: Walk forward past the fireplace on your left and enter the next room through the open door.
Continue walking past the long white table on your right and stop in the hallway of the following room.

instruction: Turn around and walk to the middle of the dining room where it is open. Once you reach this area, enter the other side of the dining room to the left of the last column on the right. Once you pass the first table, stop.

Walk forward to the middle of the dining room where the space is open.
Move left of the last column on the right to reach the other side of the dining room.
Continue forward until you have passed the first table.
Stop.

Turn slightly left and walk past the benches.
Continue down the hallway until you reach the restroom area.
Stop directly in front of the water fountain.

Turn right immediately after passing the fireplace.
Continue forward, pass the black bench on your right, then turn right into the room.
Approach the white sofa and stop beside it.

When you reach the door labeled “Restrooms”, turn left, then immediately turn right.
Continue forward and turn left at the first door you encounter.
Stop at the destination.

Turn right onto the hallway.
Walk straight down the hallway.
Stop at the end of the walkway near the plants.

Walk across the hallway, passing the water fountain.
Turn left into the next bathroom.
Stop in the bathroom.

Enter the doorway on the right.

Turn right toward the bathroom entrance.
